experience.usageZh: 作名词时，可数（具体经历）或不可数（泛指经验）。作动词时，意为“经历”。常见搭配：gain experience（积累经验）、a memorable experience（一次难忘的经历）、experience difficulties（经历困难）。

examples.sentence: My first day at school was a happy experience.
examples.trans: 我上学的第一天是一次快乐的经历。

examples.sentence: She has a lot of experience in taking care of young children.
examples.trans: 她在照顾幼儿方面有很多经验。

examples.sentence: Working part-time at the bookstore gave him useful experience for his future job.
examples.trans: 在书店做兼职为他未来的工作积累了有用的经验。

examples.sentence: Having lived abroad for three years, she has gained experience that cannot be learned from textbooks.
examples.trans: 在国外生活了三年，她获得了从课本上学不到的经验。

examples.sentence: Unlike his inexperienced colleagues, he remained calm when the project experienced a sudden setback.
examples.trans: 与缺乏经验的同事不同，当项目突然受挫时，他依然保持冷静。

examples.sentence: The study suggests that individuals who experience high levels of stress in childhood may develop stronger coping mechanisms later in life.
examples.trans: 研究表明，童年时期经历高度压力的人日后可能发展出更强的应对机制。

emotions.usageZh: 可数名词，常用复数形式。指喜、怒、哀、乐等具体情感。常见搭配：control one's emotions（控制情绪）、a mix of emotions（百感交集）、express emotions（表达情感）。

examples.sentence: I have many emotions when I watch a sad movie.
examples.trans: 看悲伤的电影时，我会有很多情绪。

examples.sentence: It is important to learn how to control your emotions when you are angry.
examples.trans: 生气时学会控制自己的情绪很重要。

examples.sentence: The farewell party was filled with mixed emotions of joy and sadness.
examples.trans: 欢送会上充满了喜悦与悲伤交织的复杂情感。

examples.sentence: Bottling up your emotions for too long can have a negative impact on your mental health.
examples.trans: 长期压抑情绪会对心理健康产生负面影响。

examples.sentence: Rather than suppressing her emotions, she chose to write them down in a journal, which proved surprisingly therapeutic.
examples.trans: 她没有压抑自己的情绪，而是选择把它们写进日记里，事实证明这样做出奇地有疗愈效果。

examples.sentence: Neuroscientists have found that the ability to regulate one's emotions is closely linked to the development of the prefrontal cortex.
examples.trans: 神经科学家发现，调节情绪的能力与前额叶皮层的发育密切相关。

reflect.usageZh: 动词。作“思考”时，常与 on 或 upon 连用，如 reflect on one's actions（反思自己的行为）。作“反映”时是及物动词，如 reflect the reality（反映现实）。作“反射”时指光、热、声音等的反射。

examples.sentence: The lake reflects the mountains like a mirror.
examples.trans: 湖面像镜子一样倒映着群山。

examples.sentence: Before you go to bed, reflect on what you did today.
examples.trans: 睡觉前，反思一下你今天做了什么。

examples.sentence: Her excellent grades reflect the hard work she has put in over the past year.
examples.trans: 她优异的成绩反映了她过去一年所付出的努力。

examples.sentence: Taking time to reflect on your past decisions can help you avoid making the same mistakes again.
examples.trans: 花时间反思过去的决定可以帮助你避免重蹈覆辙。

examples.sentence: The sharp decline in sales reflects not only the economic downturn but also a failure to adapt to changing consumer preferences.
examples.trans: 销售额的急剧下降不仅反映了经济衰退，也反映了未能适应消费者偏好变化的失败。

examples.sentence: The language we use in everyday conversation often reflects deeply rooted cultural values that we may not even be consciously aware of.
examples.trans: 我们在日常对话中使用的语言往往反映了我们甚至可能没有意识到的根深蒂固的文化价值观。

literature.usageZh: 不可数名词。指小说、诗歌、戏剧等文学作品的总称。常与 read、study、teach 等动词搭配。也可指某一学科或主题的文献资料。

family.meaning: 有读写能力的；有文化的

examples.sentence: My sister reads English literature before bed every night.
examples.trans: 我姐姐每天晚上睡觉前读英国文学。

examples.sentence: The library has a large collection of children's literature from around the world.
examples.trans: 这个图书馆收藏了大量来自世界各地的儿童文学作品。

examples.sentence: Although he majors in science, he has a deep love for classical literature.
examples.trans: 虽然他主修科学，但他对古典文学有着深厚的热爱。

examples.sentence: Studying literature allows us to explore human emotions and moral dilemmas through different perspectives.
examples.trans: 学习文学让我们能够通过不同的视角探索人类情感和道德困境。

examples.sentence: Unlike popular fiction, serious literature often demands patience and repeated reading to reveal its deeper layers.
examples.trans: 与通俗小说不同，严肃文学往往需要耐心和反复阅读才能揭示其更深层次的内涵。

examples.sentence: The professor argued that a nation's literature serves as a mirror reflecting its collective memory, values, and unspoken anxieties.
examples.trans: 这位教授认为，一个民族的文学是一面镜子，反映着它的集体记忆、价值观和未曾言说的焦虑。

emphasis.usageZh: 可数/不可数名词。常与介词 on 连用，构成 emphasis on。常见搭配：place/put/lay emphasis on（强调、重视）。也可用 strong/great/special 等形容词修饰。

examples.sentence: Our teacher puts a lot of emphasis on speaking English every day.
examples.trans: 我们老师非常强调每天说英语。

examples.sentence: The coach laid special emphasis on teamwork before the final match.
examples.trans: 决赛前，教练特别强调了团队合作。

examples.sentence: The new policy shifts the emphasis from exam scores to overall ability.
examples.trans: 新政策将重点从考试分数转向综合能力。

examples.sentence: In recent years, universities have placed increasing emphasis on interdisciplinary research.
examples.trans: 近年来，大学越来越重视跨学科研究。

examples.sentence: While the report acknowledges the importance of economic growth, its primary emphasis lies in environmental sustainability.
examples.trans: 尽管报告承认经济增长的重要性，但其首要重点在于环境可持续性。

examples.sentence: The curriculum reform reflects a deliberate shift in emphasis from rote memorization to critical thinking and independent inquiry.
examples.trans: 课程改革反映了从死记硬背到批判性思维和独立探究的有意重心转移。

practical.usageZh: 形容词。描述事物有用、有效或基于实际经验而非理论。常见搭配：practical skills（实用技能）、practical advice（切实可行的建议）、practical experience（实践经验）。

examples.sentence: My dad gave me a practical gift — a warm winter coat.
examples.trans: 我爸爸给了我一件实用的礼物——一件暖和的冬衣。

examples.sentence: Learning how to cook simple meals is a practical skill for every teenager.
examples.trans: 学会做简单的饭菜是每个青少年都应该掌握的实用技能。

examples.sentence: The course offers practical advice on how to manage time effectively.
examples.trans: 这门课程提供了关于如何有效管理时间的实用建议。

examples.sentence: Having practical experience in the field often matters more than theoretical knowledge when applying for internships.
examples.trans: 申请实习时，拥有该领域的实践经验往往比理论知识更重要。

examples.sentence: The design is aesthetically pleasing, yet it lacks practical value for everyday users.
examples.trans: 这个设计在美学上令人愉悦，但对日常使用者缺乏实用价值。

examples.sentence: Governments must balance ambitious environmental targets with practical considerations such as economic feasibility and public acceptance.
examples.trans: 政府必须在雄心勃勃的环境目标与经济可行性和公众接受度等实际考量之间取得平衡。

awareness.usageZh: 不可数名词，常与 of 连用表示“对……的意识”。常见搭配：raise/increase awareness（提高意识）、public awareness（公众意识）、environmental awareness（环保意识）。多用于正式或书面语体。

examples.sentence: Road safety awareness helps children cross the street carefully.
examples.trans: 道路安全意识帮助孩子们小心地过马路。

examples.sentence: The school held a fire drill to build students' awareness of what to do in an emergency.
examples.trans: 学校举行了消防演习，以培养学生对紧急情况下该做什么的意识。

examples.sentence: As people grow older, their awareness of health risks often becomes much stronger.
examples.trans: 随着人们年龄增长，他们对健康风险的意识往往会变得更强。

examples.sentence: Having lived abroad for two years, she developed a deep awareness of cultural differences in daily communication.
examples.trans: 在国外生活了两年后，她对日常交流中的文化差异产生了深刻的认识。

examples.sentence: Unlike previous generations, today's teenagers show a remarkable awareness of global environmental issues.
examples.trans: 与前几代人不同，当今青少年对全球环境问题表现出非凡的意识。

examples.sentence: The campaign succeeded not merely in raising awareness of the disease but also in changing how communities respond to those affected by it.
examples.trans: 这场运动不仅成功地提高了人们对该疾病的认识，还改变了社区对待患者的方式。

inspire.usageZh: 及物动词，意为“鼓舞、启发、赋予灵感”。常用结构：inspire sb. to do sth.（激励某人做某事）、be inspired by（受到……的启发）、inspire confidence/hope（激发信心/希望）。可用于主动和被动语态。

family.meaning: 灵感；鼓舞人心的人或事
鼓舞人心的；启发灵感的

examples.sentence: My big brother's love for basketball inspired me to join the school team.
examples.trans: 我哥哥对篮球的热爱激励我加入了校队。

examples.sentence: The doctor's kind words inspired the little boy to face his treatment with courage.
examples.trans: 医生温柔的话语激励了小男孩勇敢地面对治疗。

examples.sentence: The story of the disabled athlete inspired thousands of young people to keep chasing their dreams.
examples.trans: 那位残疾运动员的故事激励了成千上万的年轻人继续追逐梦想。

examples.sentence: Reading about the scientist's early failures inspired her to view mistakes as a necessary part of learning.
examples.trans: 读到那位科学家早年的失败经历，她受到启发，开始把错误视为学习的必要部分。

examples.sentence: What inspires one generation may leave the next completely indifferent, which is why great art rarely appeals to everyone.
examples.trans: 能激励一代人的东西可能让下一代完全无动于衷，这就是为什么伟大的艺术很少能取悦所有人。

examples.sentence: The documentary, by presenting ordinary people who overcame extraordinary hardships, inspired a nationwide conversation about resilience and hope.
examples.trans: 这部纪录片通过展现克服了非凡苦难的普通人，激发了全国范围内关于韧性与希望的讨论。

limited.usageZh: 形容词，意为“有限的、受限制的”。常作定语修饰名词，如 limited time/resources/space；也可作表语，如 time is limited。可用于描述数量、能力、范围等方面的不足。

examples.sentence: We only have a limited number of tickets, so buy yours today.
examples.trans: 我们的票数量有限，所以今天就买吧。

examples.sentence: The small shop has limited space, so it only sells the most popular items.
examples.trans: 这家小店空间有限，所以只卖最受欢迎的商品。

examples.sentence: Because the library has limited opening hours during holidays, students need to plan their visits carefully.
examples.trans: 由于图书馆在假期开放时间有限，学生们需要仔细规划到馆时间。

examples.sentence: With limited access to clean water, the villagers had to develop creative ways to store rainwater.
examples.trans: 由于获取清洁水源的途径有限，村民们不得不开发创造性的方法来储存雨水。

examples.sentence: A limited vocabulary does not necessarily prevent clear expression, but it certainly narrows the range of ideas one can convey.
examples.trans: 词汇量有限并不一定会妨碍清晰的表达，但它确实会缩小一个人能传达的思想范围。

examples.sentence: Given the limited data available from the early stages of the experiment, any firm conclusion at this point would be premature.
examples.trans: 鉴于实验早期阶段可获得的数据有限，此时得出任何确切的结论都为时过早。

furthermore.usageZh: 副词。用于书面语和正式演讲中，引出一个额外的、支持性的论点。通常位于句首，后接逗号。

examples.sentence: The jacket is warm. Furthermore, it is very cheap.
examples.trans: 这件夹克很暖和。此外，它还很便宜。

examples.sentence: The hotel is close to the beach. Furthermore, it has a big swimming pool.
examples.trans: 这家酒店离海滩很近。此外，它还有一个大游泳池。

examples.sentence: Reading helps you learn new words. Furthermore, it opens your mind to new ideas.
examples.trans: 阅读帮助你学习新单词。此外，它还能让你的思维接受新想法。

examples.sentence: The new software saves time. Furthermore, it reduces the chance of human error.
examples.trans: 这款新软件节省时间。此外，它还降低了人为失误的可能性。

examples.sentence: The policy has lowered costs for small businesses. Furthermore, it has encouraged more young people to start their own companies.
examples.trans: 这项政策降低了小企业的成本。此外，它还鼓励了更多年轻人创办自己的公司。

examples.sentence: The study shows that regular exercise improves memory. Furthermore, it suggests that even short walks can have a measurable effect on brain function.
examples.trans: 这项研究表明，经常锻炼能改善记忆力。此外，研究还表明，即使是短距离散步也能对大脑功能产生可测量的影响。

capable.usageZh: 形容词。常与介词 of 连用，后接名词或动名词。例如：capable of great things, capable of handling pressure。

examples.sentence: My little brother is capable of making his own breakfast.
examples.trans: 我弟弟能自己做早餐。

examples.sentence: This old phone is still capable of taking clear photos.
examples.trans: 这部旧手机仍然能拍出清晰的照片。

examples.sentence: She is a capable student who always finishes her work on time.
examples.trans: 她是一个能干的学生，总是按时完成作业。

examples.sentence: Given the right tools, the team is capable of completing the project within a month.
examples.trans: 如果工具合适，这个团队有能力在一个月内完成项目。

examples.sentence: The human brain is capable of processing vast amounts of information in a fraction of a second.
examples.trans: 人类大脑能够在极短的时间内处理大量信息。

examples.sentence: Although the engine looks outdated, it is still capable of delivering impressive performance under extreme conditions.
examples.trans: 尽管这台发动机看起来过时了，但它在极端条件下仍然能够提供出色的性能。

bonding.usageZh: 不可数名词。指通过共同活动或经历形成的情感联系。例如：social bonding, parent-child bonding。

examples.sentence: Cooking together is good for family bonding.
examples.trans: 一起做饭有助于增进家庭感情。

examples.sentence: The school trip helped create bonding between the new classmates.
examples.trans: 这次学校旅行帮助新同学之间建立了感情。

examples.sentence: Playing board games is a fun way to encourage bonding among friends.
examples.trans: 玩桌游是促进朋友之间感情的一种有趣方式。

examples.sentence: Research shows that shared laughter plays a key role in social bonding.
examples.trans: 研究表明，共同的笑声在社交联结中起着关键作用。

examples.sentence: Unlike formal meetings, informal gatherings often lead to stronger bonding among team members.
examples.trans: 与正式会议不同，非正式聚会往往能促进团队成员之间更紧密的联系。

examples.sentence: The bonding that develops between a guide dog and its owner is built on months of consistent training and mutual trust.
examples.trans: 导盲犬与主人之间形成的亲密关系建立在数月持续训练和相互信任的基础上。

priority.usageZh: 可数名词，意为“优先事项；优先权”。常与动词 give、set、make 及介词 to 搭配，如 give priority to（优先考虑）、a top priority（头等大事）。可用于日常安排、工作学习、公共政策等语境。

family.meaning: 按优先顺序处理；优先考虑

examples.sentence: My first priority after school is to finish my homework.
examples.trans: 放学后我的第一件要紧事是完成作业。

examples.sentence: We need to give priority to safety when we do experiments in the lab.
examples.trans: 在实验室做实验时，我们需要把安全放在第一位。

examples.sentence: The government has made reducing air pollution a top priority this year.
examples.trans: 政府今年已把减少空气污染列为头等大事。

examples.sentence: Having worked overtime for weeks, she decided that spending time with her family should take priority over extra projects.
examples.trans: 连续加班几周后，她决定陪伴家人的时间应该优先于额外的项目。

examples.sentence: While expanding the business is attractive, maintaining product quality must remain the company's overriding priority.
examples.trans: 虽然扩大业务很有吸引力，但保持产品质量必须始终是公司压倒一切的优先事项。

examples.sentence: In allocating limited medical resources, hospitals are often forced to set clear priorities, balancing urgency against the likelihood of successful treatment.
examples.trans: 在分配有限的医疗资源时，医院往往被迫设定明确的优先顺序，在紧急程度与治疗成功可能性之间取得平衡。

nurturing.usageZh: 动名词或现在分词，意为“培育；养育；培养”。强调通过提供支持、关爱和教育来促进成长。常见搭配有 nurturing environment（有滋养性的环境）、nurturing talent（培养人才）、nurturing relationships（滋养型关系）。

examples.sentence: My grandma is good at nurturing little plants on the balcony.
examples.trans: 我奶奶很会在阳台上养小植物。

examples.sentence: A warm and nurturing home helps children feel safe and confident.
examples.trans: 一个温暖、有爱的家庭能帮助孩子感到安全和自信。

examples.sentence: The school is committed to nurturing students' creativity through art and music programs.
examples.trans: 这所学校致力于通过艺术和音乐课程培养学生的创造力。

examples.sentence: By nurturing a habit of daily reading, parents can significantly influence their children's long-term academic development.
examples.trans: 通过培养每天阅读的习惯，家长可以显著影响孩子的长期学业发展。

examples.sentence: The foundation focuses on nurturing young researchers, providing them not only with funding but also with mentorship and collaborative opportunities.
examples.trans: 该基金会专注于培养年轻研究人员，不仅为他们提供资金，还提供导师指导和合作机会。

examples.sentence: A truly effective leader excels at nurturing diverse perspectives within a team, recognizing that innovation rarely emerges from uniformity.
examples.trans: 真正高效的领导者善于在团队中培育多元视角，因为他们认识到创新很少源于整齐划一。

compare.usageZh: 动词，意为“比较；对比”。常用结构有 compare A with/to B（将A与B比较），compare A to B 还可表示“把A比作B”。可用于比较价格、数据、观点或进行比喻。

examples.sentence: Let's compare the two pictures and find five differences.
examples.trans: 我们来比较这两幅图，找出五处不同。

examples.sentence: You should compare prices online before you buy a new phone.
examples.trans: 买新手机之前，你应该在网上比较一下价格。

examples.sentence: If you compare this year's results with last year's, you will see a clear improvement.
examples.trans: 如果你把今年的成绩和去年的相比，你会看到明显的进步。

examples.sentence: Compared with traditional classrooms, online courses offer greater flexibility but require more self-discipline.
examples.trans: 与传统课堂相比，在线课程提供了更大的灵活性，但需要更强的自律。

examples.sentence: Critics often compare the novel's narrative structure to a labyrinth, in which every turn reveals another layer of meaning.
examples.trans: 评论家们常把这本小说的叙事结构比作迷宫，每转一个弯都会揭示出另一层含义。

examples.sentence: When comparing economic indicators across countries, one must account for differences in purchasing power, population structure, and data collection methods.
examples.trans: 在比较各国经济指标时，必须考虑购买力、人口结构和数据收集方法方面的差异。

classic.usageZh: 作形容词时表示“经典的、典型的”，如 a classic example（典型例子）；作名词时表示“名著、经典作品”，如 a classic of modern literature（现代文学经典）。口语中也可表示“超棒的、绝了的”。

family.meaning: 古典的（尤指古希腊罗马或古典音乐）

examples.sentence: My dad loves classic cars from the 1960s.
examples.trans: 我爸爸喜欢20世纪60年代的经典汽车。

examples.sentence: This film is a classic—I have watched it three times already.
examples.trans: 这部电影是经典之作——我已经看了三遍了。

examples.sentence: The little black dress is a classic that never goes out of style.
examples.trans: 小黑裙是永不过时的经典。

examples.sentence: What makes a novel a classic is its ability to speak to readers across generations.
examples.trans: 一部小说之所以成为经典，在于它能够跨越时代与读者对话。

examples.sentence: Unlike trendy designs that fade quickly, classic architecture retains its appeal for centuries.
examples.trans: 与迅速过时的潮流设计不同，经典建筑历经数百年依然保持魅力。

examples.sentence: The debate over whether a contemporary work can be judged a classic before decades have passed remains unsettled among literary critics.
examples.trans: 关于当代作品能否在数十年过去之前就被判定为经典，文学评论界至今仍无定论。

nightmare.usageZh: 可数名词，表示“噩梦”或“极其糟糕的经历”。常用搭配：have a nightmare（做噩梦）、be a nightmare（是件可怕的事）、turn into a nightmare（变成一场噩梦）。口语中常用来形容麻烦事。

examples.sentence: I had a bad nightmare about a big black dog last night.
examples.trans: 我昨晚做了一个关于一只大黑狗的噩梦。

examples.sentence: Missing the last bus home was a real nightmare for us.
examples.trans: 错过最后一班回家的公交车对我们来说真是一场噩梦。

examples.sentence: The traffic jam turned a short trip into a two-hour nightmare.
examples.trans: 交通堵塞把一段短途行程变成了长达两小时的噩梦。

examples.sentence: Organizing the school festival without enough volunteers proved to be a logistical nightmare.
examples.trans: 在没有足够志愿者的情况下组织学校文化节，结果成了一场后勤上的噩梦。

examples.sentence: What began as a minor technical issue quickly escalated into a nightmare that shut down the entire system.
examples.trans: 起初只是一个小技术问题，却迅速升级为一场导致整个系统瘫痪的噩梦。

examples.sentence: For many small business owners, navigating the complex tax regulations without professional advice is nothing short of a bureaucratic nightmare.
examples.trans: 对许多小企业主来说，在没有专业建议的情况下应对复杂的税务法规，简直是一场官僚主义的噩梦。

conflict.usageZh: 可作名词或动词。名词表示“冲突、矛盾、争执”，常与 between、with、over 连用，如 conflict between A and B（A与B之间的冲突）、in conflict with（与……相冲突）。动词表示“冲突、抵触”，如 conflict with sth（与某事物相抵触）。

examples.sentence: My brother and I sometimes have a conflict about which TV show to watch.
examples.trans: 我和弟弟有时会因为看哪个电视节目而发生争执。

examples.sentence: There is often a conflict between what we want to do and what we should do.
examples.trans: 我们想做的事和应该做的事之间常常存在矛盾。

examples.sentence: If you handle the conflict calmly, both sides are more likely to find a fair solution.
examples.trans: 如果你冷静地处理冲突，双方更有可能找到公平的解决办法。

examples.sentence: The main conflict in the novel arises from the hero's struggle between duty and personal desire.
examples.trans: 这部小说的主要冲突源于主人公在责任与个人欲望之间的挣扎。

examples.sentence: Rather than avoiding the conflict altogether, the manager chose to address it directly before it damaged team morale.
examples.trans: 经理没有完全回避冲突，而是选择在它损害团队士气之前直接处理。

examples.sentence: Historians argue that the border conflict was not caused by a single event but by decades of accumulated distrust and competing territorial claims.
examples.trans: 历史学家认为，这场边境冲突并非由单一事件引发，而是数十年积累的不信任和相互竞争的领土主张所致。

strict.usageZh: 形容词。常修饰人（如父母、老师）或规则。常用结构 'be strict with someone'（对某人严格）, 'be strict about something'（对某事严格）。

examples.sentence: My dad is strict, but he always helps me with my homework.
examples.trans: 我爸爸很严格，但他总是帮我做作业。

examples.sentence: Our school has a strict rule about wearing uniforms every day.
examples.trans: 我们学校有一条严格的规定，每天都要穿校服。

examples.sentence: The coach is strict with the players because he wants them to win the match.
examples.trans: 教练对队员们很严格，因为他希望他们赢得比赛。

examples.sentence: Having grown up under strict parents, she learned to manage her time very carefully.
examples.trans: 在严格的父母身边长大，她学会了非常仔细地管理时间。

examples.sentence: The laboratory operates under strict safety protocols, whereas the workshop next door is far more relaxed.
examples.trans: 实验室按照严格的安全规程运作，而隔壁的车间则宽松得多。

examples.sentence: Strict enforcement of environmental regulations, though costly in the short term, proves essential for long-term public health.
examples.trans: 严格执行环境法规虽然在短期内成本高昂，但从长远来看对公共健康至关重要。

insist.usageZh: 动词。常用结构：'insist on (doing) something'（坚持做某事）, 'insist that...'（坚持认为/坚决要求……）。注意 insist 后接 that 从句时，从句谓语常用虚拟语气（should + 动词原形）。

examples.sentence: My little sister insists on watching cartoons before bed.
examples.trans: 我妹妹坚持要在睡前看动画片。

examples.sentence: Tom insisted on carrying the heavy box for his grandmother.
examples.trans: 汤姆坚持要帮奶奶搬那个重箱子。

examples.sentence: Although it was raining hard, she insisted on walking home alone.
examples.trans: 尽管雨下得很大，她仍坚持独自走回家。

examples.sentence: The manager insisted that every report be submitted before Friday noon.
examples.trans: 经理坚决要求每份报告在周五中午之前提交。

examples.sentence: He insisted on paying for the damage himself, despite our repeated offers to share the cost.
examples.trans: 尽管我们多次提出分摊费用，他仍坚持自己承担全部损失。

examples.sentence: Historians insist that primary sources, rather than later interpretations, form the foundation of credible research.
examples.trans: 历史学家坚持认为，一手资料而非后世的解读才是可信研究的基础。

sprawl.usageZh: 动词。可指人伸开四肢躺或坐，常与 out 连用（sprawl out）；也可指城市、建筑等无计划地蔓延、扩展。

examples.sentence: The cat sprawled on the sofa and fell asleep in the sun.
examples.trans: 猫伸开四肢躺在沙发上，在阳光下睡着了。

examples.sentence: After the picnic, the kids sprawled on the grass and looked at the clouds.
examples.trans: 野餐后，孩子们伸开四肢躺在草地上看云。

examples.sentence: He was so tired that he sprawled across the bed without taking off his shoes.
examples.trans: 他太累了，连鞋都没脱就伸开四肢横躺在床上。

examples.sentence: The city has sprawled so far into the countryside that farmland is disappearing rapidly.
examples.trans: 这座城市向乡村蔓延得如此之远，农田正在迅速消失。

examples.sentence: Unlike the compact old town, the new suburbs sprawl endlessly along the highway with little planning.
examples.trans: 与紧凑的老城区不同，新郊区沿着公路无休止地蔓延，几乎没有什么规划。

examples.sentence: Urban sprawl, driven by rising housing demand and inadequate zoning policies, continues to consume valuable agricultural land.
examples.trans: 在住房需求上升和分区政策不完善的推动下，城市无序扩张持续吞噬着宝贵的农业用地。

attempt.usageZh: 可作名词或动词。作名词时，常用搭配 'make an attempt to do' 或 'in an attempt to do'。作动词时，后接不定式 'attempt to do'，比 try 更正式，常暗示结果未必成功。

examples.sentence: My first attempt to ride a bike ended with me falling into the grass.
examples.trans: 我第一次尝试骑自行车，结果摔进了草丛里。

examples.sentence: He made an attempt to fix the broken chair before his dad came home.
examples.trans: 他趁爸爸回家之前试着修理那把坏掉的椅子。

examples.sentence: Although she knew the task was difficult, she still attempted to finish it on her own.
examples.trans: 虽然她知道这项任务很难，但她仍然试图靠自己完成。

examples.sentence: The rescue team abandoned their first attempt to reach the trapped hikers due to the heavy fog.
examples.trans: 由于大雾，救援队放弃了第一次接近被困徒步者的尝试。

examples.sentence: In an attempt to reduce plastic waste, the school replaced all disposable cups with reusable ones.
examples.trans: 为了减少塑料垃圾，学校把所有一次性杯子换成了可重复使用的杯子。

examples.sentence: Any attempt to solve the environmental crisis without addressing economic inequality is unlikely to gain widespread public support.
examples.trans: 任何不解决经济不平等问题就试图应对环境危机的做法，都不太可能获得广泛的公众支持。

volume.usageZh: 名词。表示“音量”时不可数，常用搭配 'turn up/down the volume'、'at full volume'。表示“卷、册”时可数，常用于书籍或系列作品。也可表示“体积、容量”。

family.meaning: 大量的；宽松的；卷数多的

examples.sentence: Turn down the volume, please — the baby is sleeping next door.
examples.trans: 请把音量调低，宝宝在隔壁睡觉。

examples.sentence: My grandpa listens to the radio at a very high volume every morning.
examples.trans: 我爷爷每天早上都把收音机音量开得很大。

examples.sentence: The teacher asked us to lower the volume of our discussion so that other groups could concentrate.
examples.trans: 老师让我们降低讨论的音量，好让其他小组能集中注意力。

examples.sentence: The sheer volume of data collected by the app has raised serious concerns about user privacy.
examples.trans: 该应用收集的数据量之大，已经引发了人们对用户隐私的严重担忧。

examples.sentence: Unlike the first volume, which focused on theory, the second volume offers practical case studies for language teachers.
examples.trans: 与侧重理论的第一卷不同，第二卷为语言教师提供了实用的案例研究。

examples.sentence: The volume of traffic passing through the city center has doubled over the past decade, placing enormous pressure on the aging infrastructure.
examples.trans: 过去十年间，穿过市中心的交通流量翻了一番，给老化的基础设施带来了巨大压力。

glance.usageZh: 可作名词或动词。作名词时常用 'take/have a glance at' 或 'at first glance'。作动词时常用 'glance at/over/through'，表示快速看一眼或浏览。

examples.sentence: I took a quick glance at the clock and ran out of the door.
examples.trans: 我匆匆看了一眼钟，就跑出了门。

examples.sentence: She glanced at her phone during dinner, but her mom told her to put it away.
examples.trans: 她吃饭时瞥了一眼手机，但妈妈让她把手机收起来。

examples.sentence: Before the interview, he glanced through his notes one last time to calm his nerves.
examples.trans: 面试前，他最后浏览了一遍笔记，让自己平静下来。

examples.sentence: At first glance, the two paintings look identical, but a closer examination reveals subtle differences in color.
examples.trans: 乍一看，这两幅画一模一样，但仔细检查会发现颜色上有细微的差别。

examples.sentence: He cast a nervous glance at the exit, as if he were expecting someone to walk in at any moment.
examples.trans: 他紧张地朝出口瞥了一眼，仿佛随时都在等着有人走进来。

examples.sentence: A single glance at the data was enough to convince the committee that the proposed policy would have unintended consequences.
examples.trans: 只需看一眼数据，就足以让委员会相信这项拟议政策会带来意想不到的后果。

ashamed.usageZh: 形容词，常用作表语。常见结构：be/feel ashamed of sb/sth/oneself 表示“为……感到羞愧”；be ashamed to do sth 表示“耻于做某事”；be ashamed that... 表示“因……而羞愧”。口语中也可说 What a shame! 但注意 shame 是名词。

examples.sentence: I felt ashamed when I broke my little brother's toy.
examples.trans: 当我弄坏弟弟的玩具时，我感到很羞愧。

examples.sentence: She was ashamed of telling a lie to her best friend.
examples.trans: 她因为对最好的朋友撒谎而感到惭愧。

examples.sentence: He felt so ashamed of himself that he couldn't look his mother in the eye.
examples.trans: 他对自己感到非常羞愧，以至于不敢直视母亲的眼睛。

examples.sentence: Having shouted at his colleague in the meeting, Tom was ashamed of losing his temper in public.
examples.trans: 因为在会议上对同事大喊大叫，汤姆为自己当众发脾气而感到羞愧。

examples.sentence: There is nothing to be ashamed of in asking for help when you genuinely need it.
examples.trans: 当你真正需要帮助时，开口求助并没有什么可羞愧的。

examples.sentence: Although she had achieved great success, she was ashamed to admit that she had neglected her family for years.
examples.trans: 尽管她取得了巨大的成功，但她羞于承认自己多年来一直忽视了家人。

manners.usageZh: 复数名词，表示“礼貌；礼仪”，谓语动词用复数。常见搭配：good/bad manners（有/没有礼貌），table manners（餐桌礼仪），have the manners to do sth（有做某事的礼貌）。注意与 manner（单数）区分，单数常表示“方式；态度”。

examples.sentence: My grandma always tells me to have good manners at the dinner table.
examples.trans: 我奶奶总是告诉我在餐桌上要有礼貌。

examples.sentence: It is bad manners to talk with your mouth full of food.
examples.trans: 嘴里塞满食物说话是不礼貌的。

examples.sentence: Parents should teach their children basic table manners before they visit other people's homes.
examples.trans: 父母应该在孩子去别人家做客之前教他们基本的餐桌礼仪。

examples.sentence: Showing good manners, such as holding the door for the person behind you, costs nothing but means a lot.
examples.trans: 表现出良好的礼貌，比如为身后的人扶门，不花任何代价却意义重大。

examples.sentence: It is not just about knowing which fork to use; good manners reflect genuine respect for those around you.
examples.trans: 这不仅仅是知道用哪把叉子的问题；良好的礼仪反映了你对周围人真正的尊重。

examples.sentence: In an increasingly digital world, many people argue that online manners deserve as much attention as face-to-face etiquette.
examples.trans: 在日益数字化的世界里，许多人认为网络礼仪值得与面对面礼仪同等程度的重视。

doubt.usageZh: 可作名词或动词。作名词时常用于 there is no doubt that...（毫无疑问……），have doubts about（对……有疑虑），beyond doubt（无疑）。作动词时常用 doubt that/whether/if...，在否定句和疑问句中接 that，在肯定句中常接 whether/if。

family.meaning: 怀疑的；不确定的；可疑的
毫无疑问地；毋庸置疑地

examples.sentence: I doubt that he can finish the homework in ten minutes.
examples.trans: 我怀疑他能在十分钟内完成作业。

examples.sentence: There is no doubt that our team played better in the second half.
examples.trans: 毫无疑问，我们队在下半场踢得更好。

examples.sentence: She had some doubts about whether the plan would work, but she decided to give it a try.
examples.trans: 她对计划能否奏效有些疑虑，但她决定试一试。

examples.sentence: Scientists no longer doubt that human activity is a major cause of climate change.
examples.trans: 科学家们不再怀疑人类活动是气候变化的主要原因。

examples.sentence: Despite his confident speech, a hint of doubt lingered in the minds of several investors.
examples.trans: 尽管他的演讲充满自信，但几位投资者心中仍萦绕着一丝疑虑。

examples.sentence: The authenticity of the painting was called into doubt after a detailed chemical analysis revealed modern pigments.
examples.trans: 在详细的化学分析揭示出现代颜料后，这幅画的真实性受到了质疑。

particular.usageZh: 形容词，常用搭配 'in particular'（特别地、尤其），'be particular about'（对……挑剔/讲究）。可作定语修饰名词，表示“特定的那个”，也可作表语表示“讲究的、挑剔的”。口语和书面语都常见。

examples.sentence: I like this particular song because it is easy to sing.
examples.trans: 我喜欢这首特定的歌，因为它容易唱。

examples.sentence: She is very particular about what she eats for breakfast.
examples.trans: 她对早餐吃什么非常讲究。

examples.sentence: The teacher asked if anyone had a particular reason for being late.
examples.trans: 老师问是否有人有迟到的特殊理由。

examples.sentence: He chose that particular university because it offers a strong science program.
examples.trans: 他选择那所特定的大学，因为它提供很强的理科课程。

examples.sentence: Unlike his brother, who eats anything, Tom is particular about the freshness of vegetables.
examples.trans: 与什么都吃的哥哥不同，汤姆对蔬菜的新鲜度很挑剔。

examples.sentence: The report highlights one particular finding that challenges the long-held assumption about urban migration.
examples.trans: 该报告强调了一个特定的发现，它挑战了关于城市迁移的长期假设。

vain.usageZh: 形容词，意为“徒劳的；无用的”。最常用在短语 in vain 中，表示“白费力气地；徒劳地”，作状语。也可作定语修饰名词，如 a vain attempt（徒劳的尝试）。

examples.sentence: I looked for my keys in vain, but they were not in my bag.
examples.trans: 我白找了一通钥匙，它们不在我包里。

examples.sentence: He tried in vain to fix the broken chair, so he had to buy a new one.
examples.trans: 他白费力气想修好那把坏椅子，只好买了一把新的。

examples.sentence: The doctors fought in vain to save the patient, and the family was heartbroken.
examples.trans: 医生们奋力抢救病人却无济于事，家属悲痛欲绝。

examples.sentence: Having waited in vain for over an hour, she finally decided to take a taxi home.
examples.trans: 白等了一个多小时后，她最终决定打车回家。

examples.sentence: All attempts to reach a compromise proved in vain, and the negotiations broke down completely.
examples.trans: 所有达成妥协的尝试都被证明是徒劳的，谈判彻底破裂了。

examples.sentence: Despite the rescue team's relentless efforts, their search for survivors in the rubble was in vain.
examples.trans: 尽管救援队不懈努力，他们在废墟中搜寻幸存者的行动仍然徒劳无功。

lack.usageZh: 可作名词和动词。作名词时常用 a lack of + 名词，表示“缺乏某物”，如 a lack of sleep（缺乏睡眠）。作动词时是及物动词，直接接宾语，如 lack confidence（缺乏自信）。

examples.sentence: The plant died because of a lack of water.
examples.trans: 那棵植物因为缺水死了。

examples.sentence: Many students lack enough sleep before a big exam.
examples.trans: 很多学生在大考前睡眠不足。

examples.sentence: The young player does not lack talent, but he still needs more experience.
examples.trans: 这名年轻球员并不缺乏天赋，但他还需要更多经验。

examples.sentence: Lacking clear instructions, the new employees had no idea how to operate the machine.
examples.trans: 由于缺乏明确的说明，新员工不知道如何操作这台机器。

examples.sentence: What the committee lacks in funding, it makes up for in enthusiasm and dedication.
examples.trans: 委员会在资金上有所欠缺，但在热情和奉献精神上得到了弥补。

examples.sentence: A chronic lack of investment in public transport has led to severe congestion in the city center.
examples.trans: 对公共交通长期缺乏投资已导致市中心严重拥堵。

understanding.usageZh: 不可数名词，意为“理解；谅解”。常见搭配有 have a good understanding of（对……有很好的理解）、reach an understanding（达成谅解）、mutual understanding（相互理解）。

examples.sentence: My teacher has a good understanding of my problems.
examples.trans: 我的老师很理解我的困难。

examples.sentence: Reading more books can help you get a better understanding of the world.
examples.trans: 多读书能帮助你更好地理解世界。

examples.sentence: After a long talk, the two sides finally reached an understanding about the plan.
examples.trans: 经过长谈，双方终于就这个计划达成了谅解。

examples.sentence: Having a deep understanding of local culture is essential for anyone working abroad.
examples.trans: 对任何在国外工作的人来说，深入了解当地文化是必不可少的。

examples.sentence: The novel offers readers a profound understanding of how war affects ordinary people.
examples.trans: 这部小说让读者深刻理解战争如何影响普通人。

examples.sentence: A nuanced understanding of historical context is crucial when interpreting such ambiguous documents.
examples.trans: 在解读这类模糊文献时，对历史背景的细致入微的理解至关重要。

stand.usageZh: 动词。表示“站立”时指身体直立；表示“忍受”时多用于否定句或疑问句，常与 can/could 连用，如 can't stand (doing) something。也可表示“位于、处于某种状态”。

examples.sentence: Please stand up and say your name.
examples.trans: 请站起来说出你的名字。

examples.sentence: I can't stand the noise from the road at night.
examples.trans: 我受不了夜里马路上传来的噪音。

examples.sentence: She stood by the window and watched the rain fall.
examples.trans: 她站在窗边，看着雨落下。

examples.sentence: He couldn't stand being treated like a child by his older brother.
examples.trans: 他无法忍受被哥哥当小孩一样对待。

examples.sentence: What really stands out in this novel is the author's ability to describe ordinary life with extraordinary precision.
examples.trans: 这部小说真正突出的一点，是作者以非凡的精确度描写日常生活的能力。

examples.sentence: Few historians would deny that the economic reforms of that period stand as a turning point in the nation's modern development.
examples.trans: 很少有历史学家会否认，那个时期的经济改革是该国现代发展中的一个转折点。

furniture.usageZh: 不可数名词，统称家具。表示“一件家具”用 a piece of furniture 或 an item of furniture。不能直接说 a furniture。

examples.sentence: There is a lot of furniture in my bedroom.
examples.trans: 我的卧室里有很多家具。

examples.sentence: We need to buy a piece of furniture for the hallway.
examples.trans: 我们需要为走廊买一件家具。

examples.sentence: The old furniture in the house was covered with dust.
examples.trans: 房子里的旧家具上落满了灰尘。

examples.sentence: Moving heavy furniture upstairs requires at least two strong people.
examples.trans: 把沉重的家具搬上楼至少需要两个力气大的人。

examples.sentence: The apartment is fully furnished, so you won't need to spend extra money on furniture.
examples.trans: 这套公寓家具齐全，所以你不需要额外花钱买家具。

examples.sentence: Rather than replacing all the furniture, the designer suggested rearranging the existing pieces to create a more open and functional space.
examples.trans: 设计师没有建议更换所有家具，而是建议重新布置现有家具，以营造更开阔、更实用的空间。

stare.usageZh: 动词，常与 at 连用，表示长时间、目不转睛地看，常带有不礼貌或惊讶的意味。也可作名词，如 give sb a stare。

examples.sentence: Don't stare at me like that.
examples.trans: 别那样盯着我看。

examples.sentence: The little boy stared at the big dog with fear.
examples.trans: 小男孩害怕地盯着那只大狗。

examples.sentence: She stared at the letter, unable to believe what she had read.
examples.trans: 她盯着那封信，不敢相信自己读到的内容。

examples.sentence: Caught staring at his phone during the meeting, he quickly put it away.
examples.trans: 开会时被人发现盯着手机看，他赶紧把手机收了起来。

examples.sentence: Instead of staring at the problem and feeling helpless, she decided to break it down into smaller, manageable tasks.
examples.trans: 她没有盯着问题感到无助，而是决定把它分解成更小、更容易处理的任务。

examples.sentence: Visitors to the gallery often find themselves staring at the painting for minutes, drawn in by its subtle shifts of light and shadow.
examples.trans: 参观画廊的人常常发现自己盯着那幅画看好几分钟，被画中光影的微妙变化所吸引。

more than enough.usageZh: 固定短语，用作形容词或副词，表示数量或程度超过所需。常修饰名词或作表语，口语和书面语均可使用。

examples.sentence: We have more than enough apples for the picnic.
examples.trans: 我们为野餐准备的苹果绰绰有余。

examples.sentence: She brought more than enough water for the long walk.
examples.trans: 她为这次长途步行带的水绰绰有余。

examples.sentence: The library has more than enough books on science for us to finish the project.
examples.trans: 图书馆里关于科学的书足够我们完成这个项目了。

examples.sentence: Having saved more than enough money for the trip, she decided to treat herself to a nice dinner.
examples.trans: 为这次旅行攒的钱绰绰有余，她决定犒劳自己一顿丰盛的晚餐。

examples.sentence: The evidence presented in court was more than enough to prove his innocence, yet the jury still hesitated.
examples.trans: 法庭上出示的证据足以证明他的清白，但陪审团仍然犹豫不决。

examples.sentence: Given the complexity of the task, the resources allocated were more than enough, but the lack of coordination undermined the entire effort.
examples.trans: 考虑到任务的复杂性，所分配的资源绰绰有余，但缺乏协调破坏了整个努力。

of good quality.usageZh: 介词短语，作后置定语修饰名词，表示某物具有良好品质。结构为“be + of + adjective + quality”，常用于较正式的描述。

examples.sentence: My mom bought me a bag of good quality.
examples.trans: 我妈妈给我买了一个质量很好的包。

examples.sentence: These shoes are of good quality, so they will last a long time.
examples.trans: 这些鞋质量很好，所以能穿很长时间。

examples.sentence: The school provides students with textbooks of good quality every term.
examples.trans: 学校每学期都为学生提供质量良好的教科书。

examples.sentence: To ensure customer satisfaction, the company only uses materials of good quality in its products.
examples.trans: 为了确保客户满意，该公司在产品中只使用优质材料。

examples.sentence: Unlike cheaper alternatives, furniture of good quality retains its value and appearance over decades of daily use.
examples.trans: 与更便宜的替代品不同，优质家具在数十年的日常使用中仍能保持其价值和外观。

examples.sentence: Consumers are increasingly willing to pay a premium for goods of good quality that are produced under ethical and sustainable conditions.
examples.trans: 消费者越来越愿意为在道德和可持续条件下生产的优质商品支付溢价。

increase awareness of.usageZh: 动词短语，表示提高人们对某事物或问题的认识。'increase' 为及物动词，后接 'awareness'，再接 'of' 引出认识的对象。常用于正式或社会议题语境。

examples.sentence: The poster helps increase awareness of saving water.
examples.trans: 这张海报有助于提高节约用水的意识。

examples.sentence: Our school held a talk to increase awareness of road safety.
examples.trans: 我们学校举办了一场讲座来提高道路安全意识。

examples.sentence: The new TV program aims to increase awareness of healthy eating among teenagers.
examples.trans: 这个新电视节目旨在提高青少年对健康饮食的认识。

examples.sentence: By organizing community clean-up events, the local government hopes to increase awareness of waste reduction.
examples.trans: 通过组织社区清洁活动，当地政府希望提高人们对减少浪费的认识。

examples.sentence: Documentaries that expose the harsh realities of climate change play a crucial role in increasing public awareness of the crisis.
examples.trans: 揭露气候变化严酷现实的纪录片在提高公众对这一危机的认识方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

examples.sentence: While social media campaigns can rapidly increase awareness of mental health issues, sustained change requires structural support and accessible services.
examples.trans: 虽然社交媒体活动可以迅速提高人们对心理健康问题的认识，但持续的改变需要结构性支持和可及的服务。

lost in.usageZh: 短语动词，'lost' 是过去分词作形容词，后接介词 'in' 加名词或动名词。用于描述某事物被淹没、被忽视，或某人沉浸于某事。常见搭配：be lost in thought（陷入沉思）、be lost in the crowd（消失在人群中）。

family.meaning: 丢失的；迷失的；不知所措的

examples.sentence: My little cat got lost in the park yesterday.
examples.trans: 我的小猫昨天在公园里迷路了。

examples.sentence: She was so lost in her book that she didn't hear the phone ring.
examples.trans: 她看书看得太入迷了，连电话响都没听见。

examples.sentence: The old man's voice was lost in the noise of the busy street.
examples.trans: 老人的声音被繁忙街道的嘈杂声淹没了。

examples.sentence: Without clear guidance, many valuable ideas get lost in the process of group discussion.
examples.trans: 没有明确的引导，许多有价值的想法在小组讨论过程中被忽视了。

examples.sentence: The original purpose of the festival has been largely lost in its commercial promotion.
examples.trans: 这个节日的初衷在很大程度上已经被商业推广所淹没。

examples.sentence: In an era dominated by short videos, the habit of deep reading is at risk of being lost in a flood of fragmented information.
examples.trans: 在短视频主导的时代，深度阅读的习惯正面临被碎片化信息的洪流淹没的危险。

lack of.usageZh: 名词短语，后接名词或动名词。作主语时谓语动词用单数，作宾语时常与 due to、because of、suffer from 等搭配。可加形容词修饰，如 a serious lack of、a complete lack of。

examples.sentence: The plant died because of a lack of water.
examples.trans: 这棵植物因为缺水死了。

examples.sentence: A lack of sleep can make you feel tired at school.
examples.trans: 睡眠不足会让你在学校里感到疲倦。

examples.sentence: The project was delayed because of a lack of money and workers.
examples.trans: 这个项目因为缺乏资金和工人而被推迟了。

examples.sentence: His lack of experience in public speaking was obvious during the presentation.
examples.trans: 他在公开演讲方面缺乏经验，这一点在展示过程中很明显。

examples.sentence: What worries the manager most is not the tight schedule but the team's lack of commitment to the project.
examples.trans: 最让经理担心的不是紧张的日程，而是团队对这个项目缺乏投入。

examples.sentence: A persistent lack of investment in rural infrastructure has widened the gap between urban and remote communities.
examples.trans: 对农村基础设施持续缺乏投资，拉大了城市与偏远地区之间的差距。

compare with.usageZh: 动词短语，'compare' 是动词，后接介词 'with'。'Compare A with B' 强调对比两者的异同，常用于分析或评价。注意与 'compare to' 的区别：'compare to' 多用于比喻或类比。

examples.sentence: Compare your answer with your partner's answer.
examples.trans: 把你的答案和你同伴的答案对比一下。

examples.sentence: If you compare this phone with that one, you'll see this one is lighter.
examples.trans: 如果你把这部手机和那部比较一下，你会发现这部更轻。

examples.sentence: Compared with last year, the air quality in our city has improved a lot.
examples.trans: 与去年相比，我们城市的空气质量改善了很多。

examples.sentence: When you compare the two novels, you will notice that both explore the theme of loneliness but in very different ways.
examples.trans: 当你比较这两部小说时，你会注意到它们都探讨了孤独的主题，但方式截然不同。

examples.sentence: Compared with traditional classrooms, online courses offer greater flexibility but demand more self-discipline from learners.
examples.trans: 与传统课堂相比，在线课程提供了更大的灵活性，但对学习者的自律要求更高。

examples.sentence: When compared with the data collected a decade ago, the current figures indicate a significant shift in public attitudes toward environmental protection.
examples.trans: 与十年前收集的数据相比，当前的数据表明公众对环境保护的态度发生了显著转变。

take risks.usageZh: 动词短语，'take' 是动词，后接名词 'risks'。'Risk' 常用复数形式。常与 be willing to、be afraid to、dare to 等搭配使用，口语和书面语均可。

examples.sentence: My brother likes to take risks when he rides his bike fast down the hill.
examples.trans: 我哥哥骑自行车快速冲下山时喜欢冒险。

examples.sentence: You should not take risks with your health by staying up too late every night.
examples.trans: 你不应该每晚熬夜太晚，拿自己的健康冒险。

examples.sentence: If you never take risks, you will never know what you are truly capable of achieving.
examples.trans: 如果你从不冒险，你永远不会知道自己真正能取得什么成就。

examples.sentence: Entrepreneurs who are willing to take calculated risks often stand a better chance of succeeding in a competitive market.
examples.trans: 愿意承担经过权衡的风险的企业家，往往在竞争激烈的市场中更有机会成功。

examples.sentence: While taking risks can lead to failure, it is precisely through such failures that the most valuable lessons are learned.
examples.trans: 虽然冒险可能导致失败，但恰恰是通过这样的失败，人们才能学到最宝贵的经验。

examples.sentence: The willingness to take risks, rather than mere talent or luck, is what distinguishes groundbreaking innovators from those who merely follow established paths.
examples.trans: 敢于冒险的意愿，而非单纯的天赋或运气，才是将开创性创新者与那些只走老路的人区分开来的关键。

reflect on.usageZh: 短语动词，不及物。'reflect' 是动词，后接介词 'on' 加名词、代词或疑问词从句。常用于正式或书面语境，表示深入思考。

examples.sentence: Before I go to sleep, I like to reflect on the happy things that happened today.
examples.trans: 睡觉前，我喜欢回想今天发生的开心事。

examples.sentence: After the basketball game, the coach asked us to reflect on what we could do better next time.
examples.trans: 篮球赛结束后，教练让我们反思下次哪些方面可以做得更好。

examples.sentence: When you reflect on your past mistakes, you give yourself a chance to grow and improve.
examples.trans: 当你反思过去的错误时，你就给了自己成长和进步的机会。

examples.sentence: Having spent a year volunteering abroad, she took time to reflect on how the experience had reshaped her values and priorities.
examples.trans: 在国外做了一年志愿者后，她花时间反思这段经历如何重塑了她的价值观和人生优先级。

examples.sentence: Rather than rushing to judgment, a wise leader will pause to reflect on the long-term consequences of each available course of action.
examples.trans: 明智的领导者不会急于下判断，而是会停下来仔细思考每一种可行方案的长期后果。

examples.sentence: The ability to critically reflect on one's own assumptions and biases is increasingly recognized as an essential component of intellectual maturity.
examples.trans: 批判性地反思自身假设和偏见的能力，越来越被认为是思想成熟的重要组成部分。

there is no doubt.usageZh: 固定句型，后接 that 引导的同位语从句。用于表达强烈的肯定，语气比 certainly 更正式。常见于议论文和演讲中。

examples.sentence: There is no doubt that my dog is the cutest animal in our neighborhood.
examples.trans: 毫无疑问，我的狗是我们小区里最可爱的动物。

examples.sentence: There is no doubt that eating more vegetables and fruits is good for your body.
examples.trans: 毫无疑问，多吃蔬菜和水果对你的身体有好处。

examples.sentence: There is no doubt that the Internet has changed the way people communicate with each other.
examples.trans: 毫无疑问，互联网改变了人们相互交流的方式。

examples.sentence: There is no doubt that consistent practice, rather than innate talent alone, plays a decisive role in mastering a foreign language.
examples.trans: 毫无疑问，持续的练习而非仅靠天赋，在掌握一门外语中起着决定性作用。

examples.sentence: There is no doubt that the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence will fundamentally transform the landscape of employment in the coming decades.
examples.trans: 毫无疑问，人工智能的快速发展将在未来几十年从根本上改变就业格局。

examples.sentence: There is no doubt that the preservation of cultural heritage, far from being an obstacle to progress, constitutes an indispensable foundation for sustainable social development.
examples.trans: 毫无疑问，文化遗产的保护远非进步的障碍，而是社会可持续发展不可或缺的基础。

make a priority.usageZh: 动词短语，常用结构为 make something a priority，表示把某事放在优先位置。宾语可以是名词或动名词。多用于讨论目标、时间管理、健康、教育等话题，语体偏正式但口语中也可使用。

family.meaning: 按优先顺序处理；优先考虑

examples.sentence: I make my homework a priority after school.
examples.trans: 放学后我把作业放在第一位。

examples.sentence: My parents always make family dinners a priority on weekends.
examples.trans: 我父母总是把周末的家庭晚餐当作重要的事。

examples.sentence: If you want to improve your English, you should make listening practice a priority.
examples.trans: 如果你想提高英语，就应该把听力练习放在优先位置。

examples.sentence: Having realized the importance of sleep, she decided to make going to bed early a priority.
examples.trans: 意识到睡眠的重要性后，她决定把早睡作为优先事项。

examples.sentence: Rather than spreading yourself too thin, make a few key goals a priority and pursue them consistently.
examples.trans: 与其分散精力，不如把几个关键目标作为重点，持续去追求。

examples.sentence: In an era of constant distraction, those who make deep work a priority are often the ones who achieve lasting success.
examples.trans: 在一个充满干扰的时代，那些把深度工作放在首位的人往往能取得持久的成功。

deal with.usageZh: 及物动词短语，后接名词、代词或动名词作宾语。表示处理问题、应对情况、与人打交道。可用于日常生活、工作、心理等语境。注意 deal 的过去式和过去分词均为 dealt。

family.meaning: deal 的过去式/过去分词

examples.sentence: My sister helps me deal with my little brother when he cries.
examples.trans: 弟弟哭的时候，姐姐帮我哄他。

examples.sentence: We need to deal with the broken window before it rains.
examples.trans: 我们得在下雨前把破窗户处理好。

examples.sentence: Learning how to deal with stress is an important skill for teenagers.
examples.trans: 学会如何应对压力对青少年来说是一项重要的技能。

examples.sentence: The new policy is designed to deal with the growing problem of food waste in schools.
examples.trans: 这项新政策旨在应对学校中日益严重的食物浪费问题。

examples.sentence: A good leader must be able to deal with criticism without becoming defensive.
examples.trans: 一个好的领导者必须能够坦然面对批评，而不是产生防御心理。

examples.sentence: The report examines how different countries deal with the tension between economic growth and environmental protection.
examples.trans: 这份报告考察了不同国家如何处理经济增长与环境保护之间的紧张关系。

turn into.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词，表示从一种状态、形态或性质转变为另一种。主语可以是人、物或抽象概念。常用于描述变化过程，可与 gradually、eventually、suddenly 等副词连用。

examples.sentence: Water can turn into ice when it is very cold.
examples.trans: 水在很冷的时候会变成冰。

examples.sentence: The small argument turned into a big fight between the two friends.
examples.trans: 那场小争吵变成了两个朋友之间的大冲突。

examples.sentence: With enough practice, your weakness can turn into your greatest strength.
examples.trans: 经过足够的练习，你的弱点可以变成你最大的优势。

examples.sentence: What started as a hobby has turned into a successful online business.
examples.trans: 起初只是一个爱好，现在已经发展成了一家成功的网店。

examples.sentence: If left unaddressed, minor disagreements between colleagues can turn into lasting resentment.
examples.trans: 如果不加以解决，同事之间的小分歧可能会演变成长期的怨恨。

examples.sentence: The documentary shows how a once-thriving industrial town turned into a ghost town within a single generation.
examples.trans: 这部纪录片展示了一个曾经繁荣的工业小镇如何在一代人的时间内变成了一座空城。

no more than.usageZh: 副词短语，用于名词、数字或从句前，强调数量少或程度低，相当于 only 或 just。可修饰可数名词和不可数名词，语气比 only 更强，带有说话人的主观判断。

examples.sentence: I have no more than ten yuan in my pocket.
examples.trans: 我口袋里只有十块钱。

examples.sentence: The small village is no more than two hours away by bus.
examples.trans: 那个小村庄坐公交车不过两小时的路程。

examples.sentence: The whole speech lasted no more than five minutes, but everyone remembered it.
examples.trans: 整个演讲只持续了不到五分钟，但每个人都记住了它。

examples.sentence: What he offered was no more than a temporary solution to a long-term problem.
examples.trans: 他所提供的不过是对一个长期问题的临时解决方案。

examples.sentence: The so-called luxury hotel was no more than a modest guesthouse with a fancy sign.
examples.trans: 那家所谓的豪华酒店不过是一家挂着花哨招牌的普通旅馆而已。

examples.sentence: In the eyes of the court, the document carried no more than symbolic weight, lacking any binding legal force.
examples.trans: 在法庭看来，这份文件仅具有象征意义，缺乏任何具有约束力的法律效力。

could have.usageZh: 情态动词短语，后接过去分词。表示对过去可能发生但未确定的事情的推测，也可用于虚拟语气中表示"本可以但未做"。否定形式 could not have 表示"不可能做过"。

family.meaning: 可能已经（推测，语气更弱）

examples.sentence: Tom is late. He could have missed the bus.
examples.trans: 汤姆迟到了。他可能没赶上公交车。

examples.sentence: The phone is not in your bag. You could have left it at home.
examples.trans: 手机不在你包里。你可能把它落在家里了。

examples.sentence: The lights were off, so they could have gone to bed already.
examples.trans: 灯都关了，所以他们可能已经上床睡觉了。

examples.sentence: Given the heavy traffic that morning, the accident could have been caused by careless driving.
examples.trans: 考虑到那天早上交通拥堵，这起事故可能是由粗心驾驶引起的。

examples.sentence: Had the rescue team arrived an hour earlier, the outcome could have been entirely different.
examples.trans: 如果救援队早一个小时到达，结果可能就完全不同了。

examples.sentence: The damage to the ancient mural could have been prevented had the museum enforced stricter humidity controls decades ago.
examples.trans: 如果博物馆几十年前就实施了更严格的湿度控制，这幅古代壁画的损坏本可以避免。

blame themselves.usageZh: 动词短语，'blame'为及物动词，后接反身代词或名词。表示将责任或过错归咎于某人。常用于表达自我反省或自责，语气较正式。

examples.sentence: When the ball hit the window, the boys blamed themselves for playing too close to the house.
examples.trans: 球打到窗户时，男孩们因为玩得离房子太近而责备自己。

examples.sentence: After losing the keys, my sister blamed herself for not putting them in the usual place.
examples.trans: 丢了钥匙后，我姐姐责备自己没有把钥匙放在老地方。

examples.sentence: Although the rain caused the delay, the coach still blamed himself for not checking the weather forecast earlier.
examples.trans: 尽管是下雨导致了延误，教练仍然责备自己没有早点查看天气预报。

examples.sentence: Having missed the deadline, the students blamed themselves rather than making excuses about the heavy workload.
examples.trans: 错过了截止日期，学生们责备自己，而不是拿繁重的课业负担找借口。

examples.sentence: Parents often blame themselves for their children's setbacks, yet such self-criticism rarely leads to practical solutions.
examples.trans: 父母常常为孩子的挫折而责备自己，然而这种自我批评很少带来实际的解决办法。

examples.sentence: In hindsight, the committee members blamed themselves for having overlooked the early warning signs that might have prevented the crisis.
examples.trans: 事后看来，委员会成员责备自己忽视了本可以防止危机的早期预警信号。

in vain.usageZh: 介词短语，作状语，通常置于句末。表示努力或尝试没有达到预期效果，语气略带遗憾或无奈。

examples.sentence: Tom tried to fix his toy car in vain, so he asked his dad for help.
examples.trans: 汤姆试图修理他的玩具车但白费力气，于是他请爸爸帮忙。

examples.sentence: We waited at the bus stop for an hour in vain because the last bus had already left.
examples.trans: 我们在公交车站白等了一个小时，因为末班车已经开走了。

examples.sentence: The firefighters worked through the night in vain, as the old wooden building could not be saved.
examples.trans: 消防员们彻夜奋战却徒劳无功，因为那座老木屋无法保住。

examples.sentence: Having searched the entire library in vain for the reference book, she finally turned to an online database.
examples.trans: 在图书馆里徒劳地找遍了那本参考书后，她最终转向了在线数据库。

examples.sentence: The negotiators attempted in vain to bridge the gap between the two parties, whose positions remained fundamentally opposed.
examples.trans: 谈判者徒劳地试图弥合双方之间的分歧，而双方的立场仍然根本对立。

examples.sentence: For decades, researchers strove in vain to isolate the compound, until a serendipitous discovery in an unrelated field provided the crucial breakthrough.
examples.trans: 几十年来，研究人员徒劳地努力分离这种化合物，直到一个无关领域的偶然发现提供了关键的突破。

go wrong.usageZh: 动词短语，常与疑问词（where, what, how等）连用，表示事情发展出现问题或出错。可用于描述计划、机器、关系等。

examples.sentence: My cake went wrong because I forgot to add the eggs.
examples.trans: 我的蛋糕做坏了，因为我忘了加鸡蛋。

examples.sentence: The school trip went wrong when the bus broke down on the highway.

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时：从“已完成”到“持续至今”的高中拓展用法
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense: From Finished Actions to Ongoing Relevance
grammar.usage:
现在完成时的核心结构是“have/has + 过去分词”。它不单纯描述过去发生的动作，而是强调过去动作与现在之间的联系：可能表示过去动作对现在产生的结果、到目前为止的经历、从过去持续到现在的状态，或到目前为止已经完成的次数。肯定句用“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句将 have/has 提到主语前。

与一般过去时相比，现在完成时不关注动作发生的具体过去时间，而关注该动作与现在的关联。例如“I lost my key yesterday”强调昨天丢的这件事，而“I have lost my key”强调现在钥匙不见了、影响现在。与现在完成进行时相比，现在完成时更侧重结果或完成状态，而现在完成进行时更侧重动作的持续过程。

初中阶段主要掌握 already、yet、just、ever、never、since、for 等标志词，以及“去过某地”have been to 的用法。高中阶段需要进一步理解：现在完成时在学术语篇中常用来引述研究结论或已有发现，如“Studies have shown...”；在新闻或正式文体中常与 recently、so far、to date、over the past decade 等搭配；还需辨析 have been to、have gone to、have been in 的区别，以及瞬时动词在现在完成时中不能与 for 时间段连用的问题。

易错点包括：一，把一般过去时和现在完成时混用，尤其是句中出现 just now、yesterday、in 2019 等明确过去时间时，必须用一般过去时；二，瞬时动词如 die、leave、buy、borrow 不能直接与 for 时间段连用，需转换为延续性表达，如 have been dead、have been away、have had、have kept；三，have gone to 表示“去了某地还没回来”，have been to 表示“去过某地已回来”，两者不可互换；四，在 since 引导的时间状语从句中，主句用现在完成时，从句通常用一般过去时，如“He has worked here since he graduated”。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词
一般疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词?
since + 过去时间点 / 一般过去时从句，主句用现在完成时
for + 时间段，与延续性动词或状态搭配
have been to（去过已回）/ have gone to（去了未回）/ have been in（待在某地多久）
notes: 高考书面表达中，用“have/has + 过去分词”引述研究或数据时，常与 recently、so far、to date、over the past few years 搭配，体现学术语感。
句中出现 yesterday、last week、in 2020、just now 等明确过去时间状语时，不能用现在完成时，必须用一般过去时。
瞬时动词（die、leave、buy、borrow、arrive 等）不能直接与 for 时间段连用，需转换为延续性表达，如 have been dead、have been away、have had、have kept。
在正式语域中，have gone to 表示“已去某地（尚未回来）”，have been to 表示“曾去过某地（已回来）”，两者语义不同，不可混用。
since 从句中通常用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时，如“He has lived here since he moved to the city.”

examples.en: I have already finished my homework.
examples.cn: 我已经完成作业了。

examples.en: She has never been to Beijing.
examples.cn: 她从未去过北京。

examples.en: We have known each other since we were in primary school.
examples.cn: 我们从小学起就认识了。

examples.en: Recent studies have shown a clear link between sleep and memory.
examples.cn: 近期研究表明，睡眠与记忆之间存在明确关联。

examples.en: Over the past decade, scientists have made significant progress in cancer research.
examples.cn: 过去十年间，科学家在癌症研究方面取得了重大进展。

examples.en: By now, several theories have been proposed to explain this phenomenon, but none has been universally accepted.
examples.cn: 到目前为止，已有若干理论被提出来解释这一现象，但没有一种被普遍接受。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework already.
exercises.explain: already 常与现在完成时连用，表示已经完成的动作。

exercises.q: She ______ to Beijing twice.
exercises.explain: has been to 表示去过某地已回来，twice 提示经历。

exercises.q: They ______ each other for three years.
exercises.explain: for three years 表示持续到现在的时间，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his key. He can't open the door.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙对现在有影响（开不了门），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ a panda?
exercises.explain: ever 常用于现在完成时疑问句，询问经历。

exercises.q: We ______ (live) in this city since 2018.
exercises.explain: since 2018 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ (not finish) his lunch yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于现在完成时否定句，表示还没完成。

exercises.q: I ______ (read) this book before.
exercises.explain: before 表示以前经历过，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She has went to the library.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: They have already seen that movie.
exercises.explain: already 用于现在完成时肯定句，结构正确。

exercises.q: I finished my homework. (改为现在完成时)
exercises.explain: 将一般过去时改为 have + 过去分词。

exercises.q: She has visited the Great Wall. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She has not visited the Great Wall.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: He has eaten breakfast. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 将 has 提到主语前构成疑问句。

exercises.q: I have see that film.
exercises.explain: see 的过去分词是 seen，不是 see。

exercises.q: She have finished her work.
exercises.explain: 主语是第三人称单数时用 has，不是 have。

exercises.q: —Where is Tom? —He ______ to the library. He'll be back soon.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示去了某地还没回来，符合语境。

exercises.q: I ______ my English teacher since I left school.
exercises.explain: since I left school 表示从过去到现在，用现在完成时否定。

exercises.q: So far, the students ______ more than 500 books for the library.
exercises.explain: so far 是现在完成时的标志词。

exercises.q: It's the first time that I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: It's the first time that 后常用现在完成时。

exercises.q: My parents ______ married for twenty years.
exercises.explain: for twenty years 表示状态持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The film ______ (be) on for half an hour.
exercises.explain: for half an hour 表示持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: How long ______ you ______ (study) English?
exercises.explain: How long 询问持续到现在的时间，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ (not hear) from her friend recently.
exercises.explain: recently 是现在完成时的标志词，否定加 not。

exercises.q: He has bought the car for two years.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂动词，不能与 for two years 连用，应改为 has had。

exercises.q: I have known him since we were children.
exercises.explain: know 是延续性动词，可与 since 从句连用。

exercises.q: The meeting began ten minutes ago. (用现在完成时改写)
exercises.answer: The meeting has been on for ten minutes.
exercises.explain: begin 是短暂动词，需改为延续性表达 be on。

exercises.q: He joined the army two years ago. (用现在完成时改写)
exercises.answer: He has been in the army for two years.
exercises.explain: join 是短暂动词，需改为 be in 表示持续状态。

exercises.q: I have never been to Shanghai. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have you ever been to Shanghai?
exercises.explain: 改为疑问句时 never 变为 ever，have 提前。

exercises.q: She has left her hometown for five years.
exercises.answer: She has been away from her hometown for five years.
exercises.explain: leave 是短暂动词，不能与 for 连用，应改为 be away from。

exercises.q: They have finished the work yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是具体过去时间，应用一般过去时。

exercises.q: By the time he arrived, the train ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，主句用过去完成时。

exercises.q: It is the most interesting book I ______.
exercises.explain: 最高级修饰的名词后常用现在完成时表示经历。

exercises.q: Great changes ______ in our city in the past few years.
exercises.explain: in the past few years 是现在完成时的标志。

exercises.q: She said she ______ the film twice.
exercises.explain: 主句 said 是过去时，从句用过去完成时表示之前已发生。

exercises.q: —______ you ______ your work yet? —Not yet.
exercises.explain: yet 与现在完成时连用，询问是否已完成。

exercises.q: This is the second time that I ______ (visit) the museum.
exercises.explain: This is the second time that 后用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ (work) in this company since he graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导过去时间点，主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: By the end of last month, they ______ (complete) the project.
exercises.explain: by the end of last month 是过去完成时的标志。

exercises.q: I have been knowing him for ten years.
exercises.explain: know 本身是延续性动词，不用进行时态，应说 have known。

exercises.q: The children have been playing outside since two hours ago.
exercises.explain: 现在完成进行时表示从过去持续到现在的动作，结构正确。

exercises.q: I last saw him three years ago. (用现在完成时改写)
exercises.answer: I haven't seen him for three years.
exercises.explain: last saw 转换为 haven't seen for，表示从过去到现在。

exercises.q: She began to teach English in 2010. (用现在完成时改写)
exercises.explain: begin 改为延续性动词 teach，与 since 连用。

exercises.q: He has never traveled abroad. (改为反意疑问句)
exercises.answer: He has never traveled abroad, has he?
exercises.explain: never 表否定，反意疑问句用肯定形式 has he。

exercises.q: The students have finished their homework before the teacher came in.
exercises.answer: The students had finished their homework before the teacher came in.
exercises.explain: before 从句是过去时，主句用过去完成时表示先发生。

exercises.q: It has rained since two days.
exercises.answer: It has rained since two days ago.
exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，two days 是时间段，需加 ago。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can go out to play now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去动作对现在造成的结果，所以用 have finished。

exercises.q: She ______ in this city since 2018.
exercises.explain: since 2018 是现在完成时的标志，表示从过去持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: They ______ the new movie yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于否定句，常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his keys. He can't find them anywhere.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙的结果影响现在，所以用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We ______ each other for ten years.
exercises.explain: for ten years 表示持续一段时间，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ (already / eat) breakfast, so he isn't hungry.
exercises.explain: already 常放在 have/has 和过去分词之间，表示已经完成的动作。

exercises.q: I ______ (not / see) Tom this week.
exercises.explain: this week 是尚未结束的时间段，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ (be) to Beijing?
exercises.explain: ever 常用于现在完成时的疑问句，表示曾经是否做过某事。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have visited the Great Wall last year." is correct.
exercises.explain: 有明确的过去时间 last year 时，不能用现在完成时，要用一般过去时。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has just finished her work." is correct.
exercises.explain: just 表示刚刚完成的动作，常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: I have finished my homework.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时的否定形式是在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: She has visited Shanghai.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时的一般疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "already": He has finished his lunch.
exercises.answer: He has already finished his lunch.
exercises.explain: already 通常放在 have/has 和过去分词之间。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: I have saw that movie twice.
exercises.answer: I have seen that movie twice.
exercises.explain: see 的过去分词是 seen，不是 saw。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She have lived here for five years.
exercises.answer: She has lived here for five years.
exercises.explain: 主语是第三人称单数 she，要用 has 而不是 have。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived at the station, the train ______.
exercises.explain: arrived 是过去动作，火车离开发生在 arrived 之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in this company since she graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语从句表示从过去持续到现在的动作，用现在完成进行时强调持续性。

exercises.q: I ______ my phone. I can't find it anywhere.
exercises.explain: 丢手机的结果影响现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: This is the first time I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: This is the first time 句型中常用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ to London three times so far.
exercises.explain: so far 表示到目前为止，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The children ______ (play) outside for two hours and they are still playing.
exercises.explain: for two hours 且动作仍在继续，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: She ______ (not / finish) her project yet, so she can't submit it.
exercises.explain: yet 用于否定句，表示尚未完成的动作。

exercises.q: How long ______ you ______ (study) English?
exercises.explain: How long 询问持续时间，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have known him since two years." is correct.
exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，two years 是时间段，应改为 for two years。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has gone to Beijing and will be back next week." is correct.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示去了某地还没回来，符合语境。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "since": I started learning piano in 2019 and I still learn it.
exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，表示从过去某时持续到现在的动作。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: They have already completed the task.
exercises.answer: They haven't completed the task yet.
exercises.explain: 否定句中 already 要改为 yet，并放在句末。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "just": She has finished her meal.
exercises.answer: She has just finished her meal.
exercises.explain: just 放在 have/has 和过去分词之间，表示刚刚完成的动作。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He has been lived in this house for ten years.
exercises.answer: He has lived in this house for ten years.
exercises.explain: live 是状态动词，不用进行时，直接用现在完成时。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: I have never saw such a wonderful performance before.
exercises.answer: I have never seen such a wonderful performance before.
exercises.explain: never 与现在完成时连用时，动词要用过去分词 seen。

exercises.q: It is the most inspiring book I ______.
exercises.explain: It is + 最高级 + 名词 + 现在完成时，表示到目前为止最……的经历。

exercises.q: By the end of last month, they ______ over 5000 trees in the area.
exercises.explain: by the end of last month 是过去时间点，表示到那时已完成的动作，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ on this research project for three years, and she hasn't finished it yet.
exercises.explain: for three years 且尚未完成，强调动作的持续性，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: No sooner ______ the door than the phone rang.
exercises.explain: No sooner...than 句型中，主句用过去完成时且部分倒装。

exercises.q: The scientist ______ that the experiment was a success before the funding was cut.
exercises.explain: prove 发生在 was cut 之前，用过去完成时表示过去的过去。

exercises.q: Hardly ______ he ______ (enter) the room when the lights went out.
exercises.explain: Hardly...when 句型中，主句用过去完成时且部分倒装。

exercises.q: It's high time we ______ (take) action to protect the environment.
exercises.explain: It's high time 后的从句用一般过去时表示虚拟语气。

exercises.q: She ______ (write) three novels so far, and she is working on her fourth.
exercises.explain: so far 表示到目前为止，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has been knowing her for many years." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: know 是状态动词，不能用进行时，应改为 has known。

exercises.q: The sentence "By the time he arrived, the meeting had already started." is correct.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，主句用过去完成时表示先发生的动作。

exercises.q: Rewrite using inversion: I had no sooner arrived home than it began to rain.
exercises.answer: No sooner had I arrived home than it began to rain.
exercises.explain: No sooner 置于句首时，主句要部分倒装。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "since": She started working here in 2015 and she still works here.
exercises.answer: She has been working here since 2015.
exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，用现在完成进行时强调动作的持续性。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: I have seen that film before.
exercises.answer: I haven't seen that film before.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时的否定形式是在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.answer: She has gone to the library and she will be back in an hour.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示去了某地还没回来，has been to 表示去过某地已回来。

grammar.title: 比较结构与对立概念对：从 right and wrong 到 more...than / as...as / not only...but also
grammar.titleEn: Comparative Structures and Contrastive Pairs: From right and wrong to more...than, as...as, and not only...but also
grammar.usage:
比较结构在英语中不仅用于比较人或事物的差异，也常用于呈现对立概念、并列观点或递进关系。本语法点的核心结构包括两类：一是由成对反义词构成的对比表达，如 right and wrong、good and evil、pros and cons、ups and downs，这类结构通过并列两个相反概念来形成整体概念，常见于议论、反思和总结性语境；二是由比较级或并列连词构成的比较与递进结构，如 more...than、as...as、not only...but also、rather than 等，用于表达程度差异、等同关系或双重肯定。

在肯定句中，比较结构通常直接连接两个对等成分，例如“The story explores both good and evil.”；否定句则常用“not...but...”或“rather than”来否定一方、肯定另一方，例如“The point is not right or wrong, but how we understand it.”；疑问句则常见“Which is more important, A or B?”或“Is it A or B?”的形式，用于引导选择或思考。

与近义结构对比：right and wrong 与 good and evil 都属于“对立概念对”，但前者更偏向道德判断或行为准则，后者更偏向哲学或文学语境中的善恶本质；more...than 强调程度差异，而 as...as 强调等同或平级；not only...but also 表示递进，rather than 表示取舍，二者在逻辑方向上不同。

初中阶段主要要求学生掌握比较级的基本形式（-er / more）和 as...as 的肯定、否定用法，并能识别常见的成对反义词；高中阶段则进一步要求学生在书面表达中灵活运用平行结构、对立概念对以及递进比较结构，使论证更具逻辑性和表现力，同时注意语域和正式程度。

易错点：一是比较对象不一致，例如“His idea is better than me”应改为“His idea is better than mine”；二是成对概念顺序固定，不可随意颠倒，如习惯说 right and wrong 而非 wrong and right；三是 not only...but also 连接两个主语时，谓语动词与最近的主语保持一致；四是在正式书面语中，避免用 like 代替 as 引导比较从句，例如应写“as I said”而非“like I said”。
forms: A and B（对立概念对）：right and wrong / good and evil / pros and cons / ups and downs
more + 形容词/副词 + than + 比较对象：more important than...
as + 形容词/副词原级 + as + 比较对象：as important as...
not only + A + but also + B：not only interesting but also instructive
A rather than B / not A but B：quality rather than quantity
Which is + 比较级, A or B?：Which is more valuable, wealth or health?
notes: 高考书面表达中，成对反义词结构（如 pros and cons、ups and downs）能增强议论文的概括性和节奏感，但要注意搭配固定，不可随意替换其中一个词。
比较对象必须在语法上平行：比较级前后应使用相同词性，例如“Reading is more rewarding than watching TV”而非“Reading is more rewarding than to watch TV”。
not only...but also 连接两个主语时，谓语动词遵循“就近原则”，例如“Not only the students but also the teacher was surprised.”
在正式语域中，as...as 的否定形式可用 not so...as，但更正式的书面语中也可用 less...than 来表达反向比较，避免口语化过强。
rather than 后面接动词时，通常用原形或动名词，具体取决于前面并列的成分，高考改错题常在此处设陷阱。

examples.en: We should learn to tell right from wrong.
examples.cn: 我们应该学会分辨对与错。

examples.en: The story is not only interesting but also educational.
examples.cn: 这个故事不仅有趣，而且有教育意义。

examples.en: Reading is as important as writing in learning a language.
examples.cn: 在学习语言时，阅读和写作同等重要。

examples.en: The novel explores the conflict between good and evil in human nature.
examples.cn: 这部小说探讨了人性中善与恶的冲突。

examples.en: The report weighs the pros and cons of online education rather than simply praising it.
examples.cn: 这份报告权衡了在线教育的利弊，而不是一味赞扬它。

examples.en: Not only does literature reflect social values, but it also shapes the way readers perceive right and wrong.
examples.cn: 文学不仅反映社会价值观，而且塑造读者感知对与错的方式。

exercises.q: My sister is ______ than me.
exercises.explain: than 前用比较级，tall 的比较级是 taller。

exercises.q: This book is as ______ as that one.
exercises.explain: as...as 中间用形容词原级。

exercises.q: Tom runs ______ than Jack.
exercises.explain: than 前用副词比较级，fast 的比较级是 faster。

exercises.q: Which is ______, the sun or the moon?
exercises.explain: 两者比较用比较级，太阳和月亮是两者。

exercises.q: I think math is ______ than English.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词比较级用 more 加原级。

exercises.q: My bag is heavier ______ yours.
exercises.explain: 比较级后用 than 连接比较对象。

exercises.q: She is the ______ (tall) girl in our class.
exercises.explain: in our class 表示范围，用最高级 tallest。

exercises.q: This story is ______ (good) than that one.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是不规则变化 better。

exercises.q: The sentence "He is more taller than his brother" is correct.
exercises.explain: taller 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: The sentence "This box is as heavy as that one" is correct.
exercises.explain: as...as 中间用原级，结构正确。

exercises.q: Tom is taller than Jim. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: Tom is not taller than Jim.
exercises.explain: 在 be 动词后加 not 构成否定句。

exercises.q: This book is more interesting than that one. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is this book more interesting than that one?
exercises.explain: 将 be 动词提到句首构成一般疑问句。

exercises.q: Lucy is the best student in her class. (用 better 改写)
exercises.answer: Lucy is better than any other student in her class.
exercises.explain: 最高级可转换为比较级加 any other 结构。

exercises.q: My brother is more strong than me.
exercises.answer: My brother is stronger than me.
exercises.explain: strong 是单音节形容词，比较级直接加 -er。

exercises.q: This apple is the most big of the three.
exercises.answer: This apple is the biggest of the three.
exercises.explain: big 是单音节形容词，最高级用 biggest。

exercises.q: The weather in Beijing is colder than ______ in Shanghai.
exercises.explain: 比较结构中用 that 指代前面提到的不可数名词 weather。

exercises.q: He is ______ of the two boys.
exercises.explain: 两者中较……的一个用 the + 比较级。

exercises.q: The more you read, ______ you will know.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 表示越……越……。

exercises.q: She is not ______ careful as her sister.
exercises.explain: not as...as 表示不如……，中间用原级。

exercises.q: This film is ______ interesting than that one.
exercises.explain: much 可以修饰比较级，加强程度。

exercises.q: The population of China is larger than ______ of Japan.
exercises.explain: 比较结构中用 that 指代前面提到的 population。

exercises.q: He is getting ______ and ______ (strong).
exercises.explain: 比较级 + and + 比较级 表示越来越……。

exercises.q: This is one of the ______ (beautiful) cities in China.
exercises.explain: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 表示最……之一。

exercises.q: The sentence "The more he eats, the fatter he gets" is correct.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构使用正确。

exercises.q: The sentence "She is more friendlier than her sister" is correct.
exercises.explain: friendlier 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: This box is heavier than that one. (改为同义句)
exercises.answer: That box is not as heavy as this one.
exercises.explain: 比较级可转换为 not as...as 结构表达相反比较。

exercises.q: He is the tallest boy in his class. (用 than 改写)
exercises.answer: He is taller than any other boy in his class.
exercises.explain: 最高级可转换为比较级加 any other 结构。

exercises.q: I prefer reading to watching TV. (用 like...better than 改写)
exercises.answer: I like reading better than watching TV.
exercises.explain: prefer...to 可转换为 like...better than 结构。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the best you will become.
exercises.answer: The more you practice, the better you will become.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构中前后都用比较级。

exercises.q: This is the most cheapest shirt in the shop.
exercises.answer: This is the cheapest shirt in the shop.
exercises.explain: cheapest 已经是最高级，不能再加 most。

exercises.q: The new bridge is three times ______ the old one.
exercises.explain: 倍数表达用 times + as + 原级 + as。

exercises.q: ______ the population of this city, it has grown rapidly in recent years.
exercises.explain: as for 表示至于、关于，用于引出话题。

exercises.q: He is no ______ than his brother; both are equally talented.
exercises.explain: no less than 表示不少于、不亚于，强调两者相当。

exercises.q: The situation is ______ worse than we expected.
exercises.explain: even 可以修饰比较级，表示甚至更……。

exercises.q: I have never seen a ______ film than this one.
exercises.explain: 否定词 + 比较级 表示最高级含义，意为没有比这更感人的了。

exercises.q: The ______ (careful) you are, the fewer mistakes you will make.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构表示越……越……。

exercises.q: This problem is far ______ (difficult) than that one.
exercises.explain: far 修饰比较级，difficult 是多音节词用 more。

exercises.q: Of all the subjects, I like English ______ (well).
exercises.explain: of all 表示范围，用最高级 best。

exercises.q: The sentence "He is as clever, if not cleverer than, his brother" is correct.
exercises.explain: if not cleverer than 插入语后应接 as his brother，结构不完整。

exercises.q: The sentence "The more books you read, the wider your knowledge becomes" is correct.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构使用正确。

exercises.q: He is the most hardworking student in the school. (用 no other 改写)
exercises.answer: No other student in the school is as hardworking as he is.
exercises.explain: 最高级可转换为 no other + 名词 + as...as 结构。

exercises.q: The more you worry, the less you will achieve. (改为 if 条件句)
exercises.answer: If you worry more, you will achieve less.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级 结构可转换为 if 条件句表达相同逻辑。

exercises.q: This task is not as difficult as I thought. (用 less 改写)
exercises.answer: This task is less difficult than I thought.
exercises.explain: not as...as 可转换为 less...than 结构。

exercises.q: The more he explained, the more confused I became about the situation.
exercises.answer: The more he explained, the more confused I became about the situation.
exercises.explain: 此句结构正确，无需修改。

exercises.q: She is more kinder to her students than any other teacher in the school.
exercises.answer: She is kinder to her students than any other teacher in the school.
exercises.explain: kinder 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: The story is ______ than the movie.
exercises.explain: 两者比较用比较级，interesting 是多音节词，需加 more。

exercises.q: Tom runs as ______ as Jack.
exercises.explain: as...as 中间用形容词或副词原级。

exercises.q: This book is not only interesting ______ also educational.
exercises.explain: not only...but also 是固定搭配，表示“不但……而且”。

exercises.q: The weather today is ______ than yesterday.
exercises.explain: bad 的比较级是不规则变化 worse。

exercises.q: She is the ______ student in our class.
exercises.explain: 三者以上比较用最高级，tall 是单音节词，直接加 -est。

exercises.q: My bag is heavier ______ yours.
exercises.explain: 比较级后用 than 引出比较对象。

exercises.q: This question is ______ (easy) than that one.
exercises.explain: easy 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，变比较级时 y 变 i 加 -er。

exercises.q: He is as ______ (old) as my father.
exercises.explain: as...as 中间用形容词原级。

exercises.q: The sentence "She is more taller than her sister" is correct.
exercises.explain: taller 已经是比较级，不能再加 more，应去掉 more。

exercises.q: The sentence "This is the most beautiful flower in the garden" is correct.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 beautiful 的最高级用 most，结构正确。

exercises.q: This book is more interesting than that one. (改为否定句)

exercises.explain: 在 be 动词后加 not 构成否定句。

exercises.q: Tom is taller than Jack. (改为一般疑问句)

exercises.q: This box is heavier than that one. (用 not as...as 改写，保持句意)
exercises.answer: That box is not as heavy as this one.
exercises.explain: not as...as 表示“不如……”，注意比较对象要互换。

exercises.q: She is more taller than her sister.
exercises.answer: She is taller than her sister.
exercises.explain: taller 已是比较级，不能再加 more，应去掉 more。

exercises.q: This is the most tallest building in the city.
exercises.answer: This is the tallest building in the city.
exercises.explain: tallest 已是最高级，不能再加 most，应去掉 most。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the ______ you will become.
exercises.explain: the more...the better 是固定句型，表示“越……越……”。

exercises.q: This problem is ______ more difficult than I expected.
exercises.explain: much 可以修饰比较级，表示“……得多”。

exercises.q: He is ______ of the two brothers.
exercises.explain: 两者中较……的一个用 the + 比较级。

exercises.q: The population of China is larger than ______ of Japan.
exercises.explain: 比较结构中用 that 代替前面提到的不可数名词 population。

exercises.q: She sings ______ better than her classmates.
exercises.explain: much 修饰比较级 better，表示程度更深。

exercises.q: The ______ (hard) you work, the more progress you will make.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级...the + 比较级 表示“越……越……”。

exercises.q: This film is far ______ (interesting) than that one.
exercises.explain: far 修饰比较级，interesting 是多音节词，用 more interesting。

exercises.q: Of all the subjects, I like English ______ (well).

exercises.q: The sentence "He is the most cleverest boy in the class" is correct.
exercises.explain: cleverest 已是最高级，不能再加 most，应去掉 most。

exercises.q: The sentence "This road is twice as long as that one" is correct.
exercises.explain: 倍数 + as...as 是正确结构，表示“是……的几倍”。

exercises.q: This book is less interesting than that one. (用 not as...as 改写)
exercises.answer: This book is not as interesting as that one.
exercises.explain: less...than 可以转换为 not as...as，意思相近。

exercises.q: He is the tallest student in the class. (用比较级改写，保持句意)
exercises.answer: He is taller than any other student in the class.

exercises.q: No other mountain in the world is as high as Mount Qomolangma. (用最高级改写)
exercises.answer: Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.
exercises.explain: no other...as...as 结构可转换为最高级表达。

exercises.q: The more you read, the more you will know more.
exercises.answer: The more you read, the more you will know.
exercises.explain: the more...the more 句型中第二个 more 后不需要再加 more。

exercises.q: This city is three times larger than that one is.
exercises.answer: This city is three times larger than that one.
exercises.explain: than 后的比较对象不需要重复 be 动词，直接用 that one 即可。

exercises.q: ______ the two designs, I prefer the former to the latter.
exercises.explain: of the two 表示“两者之中”，常与比较级或 prefer 搭配。

exercises.q: The new policy is no ______ effective than the previous one.
exercises.explain: no more...than 表示“和……一样不”，强调两者都不。

exercises.q: He is ______ a good teacher as his father was.
exercises.explain: as + 形容词 + 名词 + as 结构表示同级比较。

exercises.explain: the more...the more 句型，前后都用比较级。

exercises.q: Rarely has a film been ______ acclaimed by both critics and audiences.
exercises.explain: so + 过去分词 + by 结构，表示“如此被……”。

exercises.q: The ______ (careful) you are, the fewer mistakes you will make.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级...the + 比较级 句型，careful 是多音节词，用 more careful。
