exercises.explain: 否定词 + 比较级表示最高级含义，precious 是多音节词。

exercises.q: The situation is getting ______ (bad) and worse.
exercises.explain: 比较级 + and + 比较级 表示“越来越……”，bad 的比较级是 worse。

exercises.q: The sentence "He is as intelligent, if not more intelligent than, his brother" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: as...if not more...than 是插入语结构，语法正确。

exercises.q: The sentence "The more he tried, the worse the situation became" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: the more...the worse 结构正确，表示“越……越……”。

exercises.q: She is more diligent than any other student in her class. (用最高级改写)
exercises.answer: She is the most diligent student in her class.
exercises.explain: 比较级 + than any other 可转换为最高级表达。

exercises.q: The more he reads, the more he understands. (用 if 条件句改写，保持句意)
exercises.answer: If he reads more, he will understand more.
exercises.explain: the more...the more 句型可转换为 if 条件句表达因果关系。

exercises.q: This novel is not as thought-provoking as that one. (用 less...than 改写)
exercises.answer: This novel is less thought-provoking than that one.
exercises.explain: not as...as 可转换为 less...than，意思相近。

exercises.q: The more knowledge you acquire, the more you will be more confident.
exercises.answer: The more knowledge you acquire, the more confident you will be.
exercises.explain: the more...the more 句型中第二个 more 后直接接形容词，不需要再加 more。

exercises.q: He is as good a player, if not better than, his brother.
exercises.answer: He is as good a player as, if not better than, his brother.
exercises.explain: as...as 结构中第二个 as 不能省略，即使有插入语也要保留。

grammar.key: Modal Verbs for Ability / 表能力的情态动词
grammar.title: 表能力的情态动词：can / could / be able to / may / might 的用法与拓展
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verbs for Ability: can, could, be able to, may, might
grammar.usage:
表能力的情态动词主要用于表达“某人是否有能力做某事”。最核心的结构是“can + 动词原形”，表示现在或一般性的能力；否定形式为“cannot / can't + 动词原形”，表示“不能、无法”。疑问形式将 can 提到主语前，如“Can you swim?”，回答用“Yes, I can.”或“No, I can't.”。

在高中阶段，表能力的情态动词需要从 can 拓展到 could、be able to、may、might 等结构。could 可以表示过去的能力，也可以用于现在或未来的委婉表达；be able to 则能弥补 can 没有将来时和完成时的缺陷，如 will be able to、have been able to。may 和 might 在表示“可能”时，也常与能力或可能性产生交叉，尤其在书面语中表示“或许能够”。

初中阶段通常只要求掌握 can 表示现在能力、could 表示过去能力，以及 can't 表示“不可能”或“不会”。高中阶段则要求进一步区分 could 与 was/were able to：could 强调“过去具备某种能力”，而 was/were able to 强调“过去某次具体场合中成功做到了某事”。例如“He could swim”表示他过去会游泳，而“He was able to escape”强调他成功逃脱了。

易错点一：can 后面不能加 to，不能说“can to do”。易错点二：could 表示过去能力时，不能用于表示“过去某次成功做到”，此时要用 was/were able to 或 managed to。易错点三：be able to 与 can 在现在时中意思相近，但 be able to 更正式，且可用于更多时态。易错点四：cannot 在书面语中常写成一个词，而 can not 在强调否定或对比时才会分开写。
forms: 肯定：主语 + can / could / may / might + 动词原形
否定：主语 + cannot / can't / could not / couldn't + 动词原形
疑问：Can / Could / May / Might + 主语 + 动词原形?
替代结构：主语 + be able to + 动词原形（可用于各种时态）
过去成功：主语 + was/were able to + 动词原形
将来能力：主语 + will be able to + 动词原形
notes: can 后面直接跟动词原形，不能加 to；高考书面表达中“can to do”属于典型语法错误。
could 表示过去一般能力，但表示“过去某次成功做到”时，书面语中优先用 was/were able to 或 managed to，避免语义模糊。
be able to 与 can 在现在时中可互换，但 be able to 更正式，且能用于完成时、将来时和不定式结构，高考语法填空常考其变形。
cannot 在正式书面语中通常写成一个词；can not 仅在强调否定或对比时使用，语域较特殊。
may/might 表示“或许能够”时，语气比 can 更弱、更委婉，常见于学术语体或正式建议中，高考阅读中需根据语境判断其含义。

grammar.title: 被动语态：从 be done 到 seem lost / get broken / be said to do
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice: be done, get done, seem done and related passive-like structures
grammar.usage:
被动语态的核心结构是“be + 过去分词（done）”，表示主语是动作的承受者，而不是执行者。例如：The book was written in 1990. 在肯定句中，be 动词根据时态和人称变化；否定句在 be 后加 not；一般疑问句把 be 提到主语前，特殊疑问句在疑问词后接一般疑问句语序。

高中阶段要特别注意“系动词 + 过去分词”的类被动结构。课文中的 seems lost 并不是标准被动语态，而是“seem + 形容词化的过去分词”，表示“看起来被……了”。这类结构还有 look broken, sound surprised, feel disappointed 等。它们形式上像被动，但更强调状态或感知，而不是动作本身。

被动语态与近义结构需要区分。第一，be done 强调动作，而 seem/look/feel done 强调状态或印象。第二，get done 在口语中常替代 be done，强调动作的发生或结果，如 He got hurt. 第三，be said/believed/reported to do 是“据说/被认为/据报道”的固定被动结构，高中书面语中很常见。

初中阶段主要掌握一般现在时、一般过去时和情态动词的被动语态，如 is made, was built, can be seen。高中阶段要扩展到完成时、进行时、将来时、情态动词完成式以及“get + 过去分词”和“be + 过去分词 + to do”等复杂结构。

易错点一：过去分词容易与过去式混淆，尤其是不规则动词，如 write—wrote—written，被动语态必须用 written 而不是 wrote。易错点二：不及物动词没有被动语态，如 happen, appear, disappear, remain 等不能用于被动。易错点三：感官动词和使役动词在被动语态中要还原 to，如 He was made to work late. 易错点四：有些动词的主动形式表示被动含义，如 The book sells well. 这类结构不能改成被动语态。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + be + 过去分词（+ by + 执行者）
否定式：主语 + be + not + 过去分词
一般疑问式：Be + 主语 + 过去分词（+ 其他）？
get + 过去分词（口语中表被动，强调结果）
seem/look/feel/sound + 过去分词（类被动，表状态或感知）
be + 过去分词 + to do（如 be said to do / be believed to have done）
notes: 高考书面语中，be said to do / be reported to do 比 It is said that... 更简洁正式，适合用在概要写作和读后续写的叙述中。
get done 多用于口语和非正式文体，高考作文中不宜过度使用，正式书面语优先用 be done。
seem lost 这类结构不是真正的被动语态，而是系动词加形容词化过去分词，写作时不要误写成 seem lose 或 seem losing。
不及物动词如 happen, occur, exist, rise 没有被动语态，高考语法填空和改错中常考这一点。
使役动词 make, let, have 在被动语态中要还原不定式 to，如 was made to wait，这是高中阶段的高频易错点。

grammar.key: Conjunctions for Contrast / 表对比的连词
grammar.title: 表对比的连词：while / whereas / although / though / even though
grammar.titleEn: Conjunctions for Contrast: while, whereas, although, though, even though
grammar.usage:
表对比的连词用于连接两个在意义上形成对照或转折的句子成分，常见的有 while、whereas、although、though 和 even though。核心结构是“对比连词 + 从句，主句”，即连词引导的从句先陈述一个事实或背景，主句再提出与之相对或更重要的信息。while 和 whereas 侧重“对比”，常用来比较两个人、事物或情况的不同；although、though 和 even though 侧重“让步”，表示“尽管……但是……”，语气上 even though 最强，though 最口语化。

肯定句中，这些连词直接引导从句，主句用正常语序；否定句中，否定词放在从句或主句的谓语部分，位置与普通句子相同。疑问句通常不直接使用这些连词引导，但在回答或解释中可以用它们来对比不同情况。需要注意的是，although / though / even though 不能与 but 在同一句中连用，这是中英文表达习惯的重要差异。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 but 和 although 的基本用法，能表达简单的转折关系；高中阶段则要求熟练运用 while、whereas、even though 等连词构建复杂论证，在书面表达中体现逻辑层次。while 表对比时容易与表时间的 while 混淆，需要根据上下文判断：如果主句和从句之间不是时间先后关系，而是对照关系，则为对比用法。whereas 多用于正式书面语，口语中较少使用。

易错点一：although / though / even though 与 but 不能同时出现在一个句子中。易错点二：while 表对比时，从句和主句的主语可以不同，也可以相同，但谓语结构要完整。易错点三：whereas 引导的对比从句既可以放在句首，也可以放在主句之后，放在句首时后面加逗号，放在句中时前面通常加逗号。易错点四：though 可以放在句末表示“不过、然而”，相当于 however，但 although 和 even though 不能这样用。
forms: While + 从句（陈述事实A），主句（陈述对比事实B）
Whereas + 从句（对比项A），主句（对比项B）
Although / Though / Even though + 从句（让步条件），主句（转折结果）
主句 + whereas + 从句（对比项）
Though 置于句末，表示“不过、然而”
Even though + 从句（强调让步），主句（结果不受影响）
notes: although / though / even though 不能与 but 连用，这是高考书面表达中的高频扣分点，要养成“用 although 就不用 but”的语感。
while 表对比时，前后两个分句在结构上通常对等，时态可以不同，但逻辑上必须是同一层面的比较，不能一个说时间一个说结果。
whereas 属于正式语域，高考书面表达中适合用于议论文或说明文，口语中过度使用会显得生硬。
though 放在句末表示“不过、然而”时，前面通常有逗号，且不能替换为 although 或 even though，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的常考点。
even though 语气比 although 强，强调“即使……也……”，在高考阅读理解中常用来判断作者态度的强烈程度。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'could have' for Past Possibility / 情态动词 'could have' 表示过去的可能性
grammar.title: 情态动词 could have done：过去可能性、推测与高中拓展（含 could / may / might / must have done 对比）
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verb 'could have done' for Past Possibility and Speculation
grammar.usage:
“could have + 过去分词”是高中英语中表达“过去可能性”的核心结构之一，常用来对过去已经发生的事情进行推测，表示“当时可能发生过某事”“本来有可能做某事（但实际未必发生）”。其核心结构为：主语 + could have + 过去分词。肯定式表示对过去情况的推测或可能性；否定式为 could not have + 过去分词，表示“过去不可能发生”；疑问式将 could 提至主语前，构成 Could + 主语 + have + 过去分词？，用于询问过去是否可能发生某事。

在近义结构对比上，could have done 与 may have done、might have done 都可表示过去可能性，但语气和确定性不同：may have done 表示“可能已经做了”，可能性相对较大；might have done 可能性更小，语气更弱；could have done 则侧重“客观上存在这种可能”，常带有“本可以但未必发生”的隐含意味。此外，must have done 表示对过去情况非常有把握的肯定推测，意为“一定已经做了”，语气最强，不可与 could have done 混用。

初中阶段，学生主要接触 could 表示“过去的能力”或“礼貌请求”，例如 He could swim when he was five。高中阶段则要求掌握 could have done 表示“过去可能性”的用法，并能与 may/might/must have done 进行辨析。高考中常在完形填空、语法填空和阅读理解中考查该结构，尤其在语境中判断说话人对过去事件的推测程度。

易错点一：could have done 表示过去可能性时，不能与表示现在能力的 could 混淆。例如 He could swim 指“他过去会游泳”，而 He could have swum across the river 指“他当时本可能游过河去”。易错点二：could have done 有时带有“本可以但实际未做”的虚拟意味，需结合上下文判断是“推测”还是“遗憾”。易错点三：否定式 could not have done 表示“过去不可能发生”，语气较强，不要误写成 could have not done。易错点四：在书面表达中，could have done 常与过去时间状语连用，如 yesterday、last week、at that time 等，以明确时间背景。
forms: 主语 + could have + 过去分词（表示过去可能发生）
主语 + could not have + 过去分词（表示过去不可能发生）
Could + 主语 + have + 过去分词？（询问过去是否可能发生）
主语 + may/might have + 过去分词（过去可能，语气较 could 弱或不确定）
主语 + must have + 过去分词（过去一定已经发生，肯定推测）
notes: 高考中，could have done 常与 may/might/must have done 放在同一题中辨析，需根据上下文判断推测的确定程度。
书面语中，could have done 表示“本可以但未做”时，常隐含遗憾或批评语气，注意与单纯推测区分。
否定式 could not have done 语气较强，表示“过去不可能发生”，不要写成 could have not done。
在正式语域中，could have done 表推测时通常需要过去时间语境支撑，避免孤立使用造成歧义。
注意 could have done 与 was/were able to do 的区别：后者强调“过去确实做到了”，前者只表示“有可能但未必做到”。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense 'has forgotten' / 现在完成时 'has forgotten'
grammar.title: 现在完成时：has/have forgotten 及其与一般过去时、情态动词的拓展
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense: 'has/have forgotten' and Its Extension with Past Simple and Modals
grammar.usage:
现在完成时由“have/has + 过去分词”构成，核心功能是把一个过去发生的动作与现在联系起来。以 forget 为例：He has forgotten 表示“他过去某个时间忘了，而现在的状态是不记得/没想起来”，重点不在“什么时候忘的”，而在“现在的结果或影响”。肯定句用 have/has + forgotten；否定句在 have/has 后加 not，即 haven't/hasn't forgotten；疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前，如 Has he forgotten...? 回答用 Yes, he has. / No, he hasn't.

与一般过去时对比：一般过去时（He forgot）只陈述过去某个具体时间发生的动作，常与 yesterday、last week、just now 等明确的过去时间状语连用；现在完成时（He has forgotten）不强调过去时间点，而强调对现在的影响，常与 already、yet、just、ever、never、so far、up to now 等连用。如果句中有明确的过去时间状语，通常只能用一般过去时，不能用现在完成时。

初中阶段主要掌握 have/has + 过去分词的基本构成，以及 already/yet/just/ever/never 的搭配；高中阶段则要进一步理解现在完成时与一般过去时在语境中的细微差别，掌握 have been to / have gone to 的区别，以及现在完成时在 since/for 引导的时间状语中的用法。此外，高中还会涉及现在完成时的被动语态（has/have been + 过去分词）以及在书面语中替代口语化表达的正式用法。

易错点：一是把 have/has 与过去分词拆开，误写成 He has forgot；二是看到“过去”含义就用现在完成时，忽略了句中是否有明确过去时间状语；三是混淆 have been to（去过某地，人已回来）和 have gone to（去了某地，人还没回来）；四是在 since 引导的时间状语从句中，主句用现在完成时，从句常用一般过去时，如 He has changed a lot since he left school.
forms: 肯定式：主语 + have/has + 过去分词（He has forgotten the rules.）
否定式：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词（He hasn't forgotten the rules.）
一般疑问式：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词？（Has he forgotten the rules?）
特殊疑问式：疑问词 + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词？（What has he forgotten?）
since/for 时间状语：主语 + have/has + 过去分词 + since + 过去时间点/一般过去时从句；或 + for + 时间段
被动语态：主语 + have/has + been + 过去分词（The rules have been forgotten.）
notes: forget 的过去分词是 forgotten，不是 forgot；高考书面语中要避免写成 He has forgot。
现在完成时不能与 yesterday、last week、just now、in 2010 等明确的过去时间状语连用，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
have been to 表示“去过某地（已回来）”，have gone to 表示“去了某地（还没回来）”，两者在语境中的选择是高中阶段的重要区分点。
在 since 引导的时间状语从句中，从句用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时，如 He has forgotten many things since he got old. 这是书面语中常见的复合句结构。
口语中常把 have/has 缩写为 've/'s，如 He's forgotten，但正式书面语中应根据语域选择是否使用缩写形式。

exercises.q: She said that she has finished her homework.
exercises.answer: She said that she had finished her homework.
exercises.explain: 主句 said 是过去时，从句中表示之前完成的动作用过去完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ his homework, so he can't go out to play now.
exercises.explain: 强调过去未完成对现在造成的影响（现在不能出去玩），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ my keys. Can you help me find them?
exercises.explain: 钥匙丢了这一过去动作对现在有影响（现在找不到），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ that movie twice. She really likes it.
exercises.explain: 表示从过去到现在的经历，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: They ______ to Beijing. They will come back next week.
exercises.explain: have gone 表示“去了某地还没回来”，符合语境。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his leg, so he can't play football this month.
exercises.explain: 腿伤是过去发生的，但对现在造成影响（这个月不能踢球），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ (forget) all the manners we taught him.
exercises.explain: 主语是第三人称单数，现在完成时用 has + 过去分词。

exercises.q: I ______ (not finish) my breakfast yet.
exercises.explain: yet 常与现在完成时连用，否定形式用 haven't + 过去分词。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ (be) to Shanghai?
exercises.explain: ever 表示“曾经”，用于现在完成时疑问句。

exercises.q: 句子 "He has forgotten his homework yesterday." 语法正确。
exercises.explain: 现在完成时不与表示过去的具体时间（yesterday）连用。

exercises.q: 句子 "She has lived here since 2020." 语法正确。
exercises.explain: since + 过去时间点常与现在完成时连用，表示动作持续到现在。

exercises.q: He has finished his homework. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定形式在 has/have 后加 not。

exercises.q: I have seen that film. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时一般疑问句将 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: She has already cleaned the room. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She hasn't cleaned the room yet.
exercises.explain: already 用于肯定句，否定句中通常改为 yet。

exercises.q: He have forgotten his book at home.
exercises.answer: He has forgotten his book at home.
exercises.explain: 主语是第三人称单数，现在完成时应用 has 而非 have。

exercises.q: I have saw this movie before.
exercises.answer: I have seen this movie before.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时中动词要用过去分词，see 的过去分词是 seen。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived at the station, the train ______.
exercises.explain: arrived 是过去动作，火车离开发生在 arrived 之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in this city since she was a child.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时表示持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: — Where is Tom? — He ______ to the library. He'll be back in an hour.
exercises.explain: has gone 表示“去了某地还没回来”，符合语境。

exercises.q: I ______ my English teacher three times this week.
exercises.explain: this week 是包括现在在内的时间段，常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: He ______ the book for two weeks. He needs to return it to the library.
exercises.explain: for two weeks 表示持续一段时间，borrow 是短暂动词，需用延续性动词 keep。

exercises.q: It's the first time that I ______ (visit) the Great Wall.
exercises.explain: It's the first time that 从句中常用现在完成时。

exercises.q: So far, the students ______ (learn) more than 2,000 English words.
exercises.explain: so far 意为“到目前为止”，常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: He ______ (work) in this company since he graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时表示持续动作。

exercises.q: 句子 "I have bought this bike for three years." 语法正确。
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂动词，不能与 for three years 连用，应改为 have had。

exercises.q: 句子 "He has been to Beijing twice." 表示他曾经去过北京两次。
exercises.explain: have been to 表示“曾经去过某地”，符合句意。

exercises.q: He came to this school three years ago. (用 since 改写为现在完成时)
exercises.answer: He has been in this school since three years ago.
exercises.explain: since + 过去时间点与现在完成时连用，come 需改为延续性表达 be in。

exercises.q: I have never read such an interesting book. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have you ever read such an interesting book?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时一般疑问句将 have 提前，never 改为 ever。

exercises.q: The film began ten minutes ago. (用 for ten minutes 改写)
exercises.answer: The film has been on for ten minutes.
exercises.explain: begin 是短暂动词，与 for 时间段连用需改为延续性表达 be on。

exercises.q: She has joined the club for two years.
exercises.answer: She has been in the club for two years.
exercises.explain: join 是短暂动词，不能与 for two years 连用，应改为延续性表达 be in。

exercises.q: I haven't seen him since two years.
exercises.answer: I haven't seen him for two years.
exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，for 后接时间段，two years 是时间段，应用 for。

exercises.q: Not until he left his hometown ______ how much he loved it.
exercises.explain: Not until 置于句首，主句需部分倒装，且用一般过去时。

exercises.q: By the end of last month, they ______ more than 5,000 trees.
exercises.explain: by the end of last month 表示“到上个月末为止”，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: It is the most inspiring speech that I ______.
exercises.explain: It is + 最高级 + that 从句中常用现在完成时，表示“到目前为止最……的”。

exercises.q: Hardly ______ the office when the phone rang.
exercises.explain: Hardly...when 结构中，hardly 置于句首需部分倒装，且主句用过去完成时。

exercises.q: The old man ______ in this neighborhood for over thirty years, and he knows everyone here.
exercises.explain: for over thirty years 表示持续到现在的动作，用现在完成进行时强调持续性。

exercises.q: He ______ (forget) all the manners we taught him, which disappointed us greatly.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调过去的遗忘对现在造成的影响（我们现在很失望）。

exercises.q: This is the second time that he ______ (make) the same mistake.
exercises.explain: This is the second time that 从句中常用现在完成时。

exercises.q: Ever since he moved to the city, he ______ (not contact) his old friends.
exercises.explain: ever since 引导时间状语，主句用现在完成时表示从过去持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: 句子 "He has forgotten his manners long before he came to the party." 语法正确。
exercises.explain: forget 发生在 came 之前，应用过去完成时 had forgotten。

exercises.q: 句子 "She has been studying English for six years by the time she graduated." 语法正确。
exercises.explain: by the time she graduated 是过去时间，应用过去完成进行时 had been studying。

exercises.q: He forgot all the manners we taught him. (用现在完成时改写，强调对现在的影响)
exercises.answer: He has forgotten all the manners we taught him.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调过去动作对现在造成的影响或结果。

exercises.q: I last saw him five years ago. (用现在完成时改写)
exercises.answer: I haven't seen him for five years.
exercises.explain: last saw...ago 可转换为现在完成时的否定形式 + for 时间段。

exercises.q: She began to teach English in 2015. (用 since 改写为现在完成时)
exercises.explain: since + 过去时间点与现在完成时连用，begin 需改为延续性动词 teach。

exercises.q: Having finished his homework, the TV was turned on by him.
exercises.answer: Having finished his homework, he turned on the TV.
exercises.explain: 现在分词短语的逻辑主语应与主句主语一致，主句主语应为 he 而非 the TV。

exercises.q: He has been knowing her since they were in primary school.
exercises.answer: He has known her since they were in primary school.
exercises.explain: know 是状态动词，通常不用于进行时态，应用现在完成时 has known。

grammar.key: Subject-Verb Agreement after 'whenever' / 'whenever' 后的主谓一致
grammar.title: whenever 引导的时间状语从句及其主谓一致（拓展至 when / if / although / as soon as 等从句）
grammar.titleEn: Subject-Verb Agreement after 'whenever' and Related Subordinators
grammar.usage:
本语法点核心在于：whenever 作为连词，意为“每当；无论什么时候”，引导一个时间状语从句。该从句拥有自己的主语和谓语，谓语动词必须在人称和数上与从句内部的主语保持一致，而不是与主句主语保持一致。基本结构为：主句 + whenever + 从句主语 + 从句谓语。例如：He stands up whenever a guest enters the room. 从句主语是 a guest，单数第三人称，因此动词用 enters，而不是 enter。

肯定句中，从句动词根据从句主语的人称和数进行变化；否定句在从句动词前加 do/does/did not 或情态动词否定式；疑问句通常针对主句提问，从句保持陈述语序。例如：Does he stand up whenever a guest enters the room? 否定：He doesn't stand up whenever a guest enters the room.

与 when 相比，whenever 更强调“每一次、任何一次”，带有反复性和无条件性；when 则更中性，可指一次或多次。与 if 相比，whenever 表示时间上的反复，if 表示条件上的假设。与 although 相比，although 表示让步，不涉及时间频率。高中阶段还常将 whenever 与 no matter when 互换，但 no matter when 语气更强烈，多用于让步状语从句，而 whenever 更常见于时间状语从句。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 whenever 从句中动词与从句主语一致，避免受主句主语干扰。高中阶段则进一步要求：在书面语中准确处理复合句中的主谓一致；识别 whenever 与 no matter when 的语域差异；在从句主语为集合名词、不定代词、动名词或名词性从句时，正确判断单复数；以及注意 there be 句型在 whenever 从句中的主谓一致。

易错点一：误把主句主语当成从句主语。例如主句主语是 he，从句主语是 a guest，不能因为主句是第三人称单数就认为从句动词也用第三人称单数，反之亦然。易错点二：从句主语为复数时仍用单数动词。例如 whenever guests enter the room 中 guests 是复数，动词用 enter。易错点三：把 whenever 当成疑问词，在从句中使用疑问语序。例如错误：whenever does he come；正确：whenever he comes。易错点四：在书面表达中过度使用 no matter when 替代 whenever，导致语域不自然。
forms: 主句 + whenever + 从句主语（单数第三人称）+ 动词第三人称单数形式
主句 + whenever + 从句主语（复数/第一、二人称）+ 动词原形
主句 + whenever + there + be 动词（单数/复数取决于后面的名词）
主句 + no matter when + 从句主语 + 从句谓语（让步语气，书面语）
Whenever + 从句主语 + 从句谓语, 主句（从句前置，逗号分隔）
主句 + whenever + 从句主语 + 情态动词 + 动词原形
notes: 高考书面表达中，whenever 从句的动词形式错误属于主谓一致类硬伤，会直接影响语法准确性得分。
在正式语域中，whenever 比 no matter when 更常用于时间状语从句；no matter when 更偏向让步含义，不宜随意互换。
当 whenever 从句的主语是 everyone、someone、nobody 等不定代词时，谓语动词用单数形式。
当 whenever 从句的主语是集合名词如 family、team 时，需根据语境判断其整体性或成员性，再决定动词单复数。
注意 whenever 从句中如果出现 there be 结构，be 动词的单复数取决于其后的名词，而不是 whenever 本身。

examples.en: Whenever a guest enters the room, he stands up.
examples.cn: 每当有客人进入房间，他就站起来。

examples.en: She feels happy whenever her friends visit her.
examples.cn: 每当她的朋友们来看她，她就感到开心。

examples.en: Whenever there is a problem, the manager takes responsibility.
examples.cn: 每当出现问题时，经理都会承担责任。

examples.en: Whenever the committee meets, it discusses the budget first.
examples.cn: 每当委员会开会，它首先讨论预算。

examples.en: No matter when you arrive, you will be welcomed by the host.
examples.cn: 无论你什么时候到达，都会受到主人的欢迎。

examples.en: Whenever a new theory emerges, scientists are expected to examine the evidence critically.
examples.cn: 每当一种新理论出现时，科学家们都应当以批判的态度审视证据。

exercises.q: My little brother smiles at me whenever he ______ me.
exercises.explain: whenever 引导的从句中主语 he 是第三人称单数，动词要用 sees。

exercises.q: Whenever the teacher ______ the classroom, the students become quiet.
exercises.explain: 从句主语 the teacher 是单数，动词用 enters。

exercises.q: My dog barks whenever someone ______ the doorbell.
exercises.explain: someone 是不定代词，作主语时动词用第三人称单数形式。

exercises.q: Whenever it ______, the ground gets wet.
exercises.explain: it 作主语表示天气时，动词用第三人称单数 rains。

exercises.q: My parents always cheer for me whenever I ______ a goal.
exercises.explain: 从句主语是 I，动词用原形 score。

exercises.q: Whenever the baby ______ (cry), his mother comes quickly.
exercises.explain: 主语 the baby 是单数，动词 cry 要变为 cries。

exercises.q: My sister turns on the light whenever she ______ (get) home at night.
exercises.explain: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，动词用 gets。

exercises.q: Whenever the children ______ (play) outside, they have a lot of fun.
exercises.explain: 主语 the children 是复数，动词用原形 play。

exercises.q: Whenever a guest enter the room, he should stand up.
exercises.explain: 主语 a guest 是单数，enter 应改为 enters。

exercises.q: Whenever the sun shines, we feel warm.
exercises.explain: 主语 the sun 是单数，动词 shines 形式正确。

exercises.q: Whenever he sees a dog, he runs away. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: Whenever he doesn't see a dog, he doesn't run away.
exercises.explain: 否定句在动词前加 doesn't，动词恢复原形。

exercises.q: She smiles whenever she meets her friends. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Does she smile whenever she meets her friends?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句借助 Does 开头，动词用原形。

exercises.q: Whenever the phone rings, my mom answers it. (对划线部分提问：my mom)
exercises.answer: Who answers it whenever the phone rings?
exercises.explain: 对主语 my mom 提问用 who，语序不变。

exercises.q: Whenever my friends comes to my house, we play games.
exercises.answer: Whenever my friends come to my house, we play games.
exercises.explain: 主语 my friends 是复数，comes 应改为 come。

exercises.q: Whenever the cat hear a noise, it hides under the bed.
exercises.answer: Whenever the cat hears a noise, it hides under the bed.
exercises.explain: 主语 the cat 是单数，hear 应改为 hears。

exercises.q: Whenever Tom ______ late, his mother gets worried.
exercises.explain: 主语 Tom 是第三人称单数，动词短语用 stays up。

exercises.q: Whenever the students ______ a test, they feel nervous.
exercises.explain: 主语 the students 是复数，动词用原形 have。

exercises.q: My grandmother tells me a story whenever I ______ her.
exercises.explain: 从句主语是 I，动词用原形 visit。

exercises.q: Whenever there ______ a football match, my father watches it on TV.
exercises.explain: there be 句型中 be 动词与后面的名词 a football match 保持一致，用 is。

exercises.q: Whenever the weather ______ nice, we go for a walk in the park.
exercises.explain: 主语 the weather 是不可数名词，动词用 is。

exercises.q: Whenever my brother ______ (watch) TV, he forgets to do his homework.
exercises.explain: 主语 my brother 是单数，动词 watch 加 es。

exercises.q: Whenever the teachers ______ (have) a meeting, the students study by themselves.
exercises.explain: 主语 the teachers 是复数，动词用原形 have。

exercises.q: Whenever it ______ (snow), the children make snowmen.
exercises.explain: it 作主语表示天气，动词 snow 加 s。

exercises.q: Whenever the boys plays basketball, they sweat a lot.
exercises.explain: 主语 the boys 是复数，plays 应改为 play。

exercises.q: Whenever my aunt comes to visit, she brings gifts for us.
exercises.explain: 主语 my aunt 是单数，comes 和 brings 形式都正确。

exercises.q: Whenever he feels tired, he drinks coffee. (用 can 改写，表示能力)
exercises.answer: Whenever he feels tired, he can drink coffee.
exercises.explain: 用 can 表示有能力做某事，后面接动词原形。

exercises.q: Whenever the baby is hungry, it cries. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: Whenever the baby is not hungry, it doesn't cry.
exercises.explain: 否定句在 be 动词后加 not，实义动词前加 doesn't。

exercises.q: Whenever she goes shopping, she buys a lot of things. (对划线部分提问：a lot of things)
exercises.answer: What does she buy whenever she goes shopping?
exercises.explain: 对宾语提问用 what，疑问句借助 does。

exercises.q: Whenever the class start, the students stop talking.
exercises.answer: Whenever the class starts, the students stop talking.
exercises.explain: 主语 the class 是单数，start 应改为 starts。

exercises.q: Whenever my parents goes out, I look after my little sister.
exercises.answer: Whenever my parents go out, I look after my little sister.
exercises.explain: 主语 my parents 是复数，goes 应改为 go。

exercises.q: Whenever a guest ______ the room, the host should stand up to greet him.
exercises.explain: 从句主语 a guest 是单数，动词用 enters。

exercises.q: Whenever the committee ______ a decision, all members must follow it.
exercises.explain: the committee 作为整体看待时是单数，动词用 makes。

exercises.q: Whenever either of the twins ______ late, their teacher gets angry.
exercises.explain: either of 作主语时谓语动词用单数形式。

exercises.q: Whenever the news ______ broadcast, people stop to listen.
exercises.explain: news 是不可数名词，谓语动词用单数 is。

exercises.q: Whenever neither of the answers ______ correct, the teacher explains again.
exercises.explain: neither of 作主语时谓语动词用单数形式。

exercises.q: Whenever the number of students ______ (increase), the school needs more classrooms.
exercises.explain: the number of 作主语时谓语动词用单数形式。

exercises.q: Whenever a variety of flowers ______ (bloom) in the garden, many visitors come to see them.
exercises.explain: a variety of 后接复数名词时谓语动词用复数形式。

exercises.q: Whenever the police ______ (arrive), the crowd calms down.
exercises.explain: the police 是复数名词，谓语动词用复数形式。

exercises.q: Whenever a guest enter the room, he should stand up.
exercises.explain: 主语 a guest 是单数，enter 应改为 enters。

exercises.q: Whenever the data is collected, the researchers analyze it carefully.
exercises.explain: data 在正式语境中可作不可数名词，谓语动词用单数 is。

exercises.q: Whenever he is asked a question, he answers confidently. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Whenever a question is asked to him, it is answered confidently by him.
exercises.explain: 被动语态将宾语提前，动词变为 be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: Whenever she has free time, she reads novels. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: Whenever she has free time, she is able to read novels.
exercises.explain: be able to 表示有能力做某事，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Whenever the manager gives a speech, the employees listen carefully. (改为倒装句)
exercises.answer: Whenever does the manager give a speech, the employees listen carefully.
exercises.explain: 倒装句将助动词提前，注意主谓一致。

exercises.q: Whenever a group of students gathers in the hall, the principal makes an announcement.
exercises.answer: Whenever a group of students gather in the hall, the principal makes an announcement.
exercises.explain: a group of 后接复数名词时谓语动词可用复数形式，强调群体中的个体。

exercises.q: Whenever the majority of the population support the new policy, the government implements it.
exercises.answer: Whenever the majority of the population supports the new policy, the government implements it.
exercises.explain: the majority of 后接不可数名词时谓语动词用单数形式。

exercises.q: Whenever my brother ______ home late, my mother gets worried.
exercises.explain: whenever 引导的从句中主语 my brother 是单数，动词用第三人称单数 comes。

exercises.q: She turns off the lights whenever she ______ the room.
exercises.explain: 从句主语 she 是单数，动词用 leaves，与主句主语一致但需独立判断。

exercises.q: Whenever the children ______ outside, they make a lot of noise.
exercises.explain: 从句主语 the children 是复数，动词用原形 play。

exercises.q: My father always smiles whenever he ______ my little sister dancing.
exercises.explain: 从句主语 he 是单数，动词用 watches。

exercises.q: Whenever the teacher ______ a question, the students raise their hands.
exercises.explain: 从句主语 the teacher 是单数，动词用 asks。

exercises.q: Whenever it ______ (rain), the road gets wet.

exercises.q: The device sends an alert whenever an error is detected. (改为一般疑问句)

grammar.key: Past Tense Sequence in Narration / 叙述中的过去时态序列
grammar.title: 叙述中的过去时态序列：一般过去时与过去进行时的配合（拓展至过去完成时）
grammar.titleEn: Past Tense Sequence in Narration: Simple Past, Past Continuous and Past Perfect
grammar.usage:
叙述过去发生的事情时，英语需要依靠一套相互配合的过去时态来标明动作之间的时间关系。最核心的结构是：以一般过去时（Simple Past）叙述主要动作或事件，以过去进行时（Past Continuous）描写某一过去时刻正在进行的背景动作，以过去完成时（Past Perfect）交代“过去的过去”。三者分工不同，不能随意互换。

肯定句中，一般过去时用动词过去式，如 visited、saw、made；过去进行时用 was/were + doing，如 was walking、were dancing；过去完成时用 had + done，如 had left、had finished。否定形式分别在动词前加 did not（didn't）、was/were not（wasn't/weren't）、had not（hadn't）。疑问形式将 did、was/were、had 提到主语前。

与近义结构对比：一般过去时强调动作已经完成，是叙述的主线；过去进行时强调动作在某个过去时间点正在进行，常与 when、as、while 连用，用来提供背景画面；过去完成时则用于说明某个动作发生在另一个过去动作之前，常与 by the time、before、after 等连用。三者常在同一段落中交替出现，形成清晰的叙述层次。

初中阶段主要要求掌握一般过去时和过去进行时的基本区分，尤其是 when 引导的时间状语从句中“一个动作正在进行，另一个动作突然发生”的模式。高中阶段则进一步要求：在完形填空、读后续写和书面表达中，能够有意识地运用过去完成时交代事件先后顺序，并能在一段叙述中保持时态一致，避免无理由的时态跳脱。

易错点一：叙述主线动作误用过去进行时。例如把“I saw him enter the room”写成“I was seeing him enter the room”，see 表示瞬间结果，不用于进行时表主线。易错点二：when 从句中两个动作的时态搭配混乱。若两个动作一长一短，长的用过去进行时，短的用一般过去时；若两个动作先后发生，则都用一般过去时。易错点三：该用过去完成时的地方只用一般过去时，导致先后关系不清。例如“He told me he lost his key”不如“He told me he had lost his key”准确。易错点四：整段叙述时态不统一，前面用过去时，后面突然跳到现在时，造成叙述视角混乱。
forms: 一般过去时（主线动作）：主语 + 动词过去式（+ 其他）
过去进行时（背景/进行中的动作）：主语 + was/were + 现在分词（+ 其他）
过去完成时（过去的过去）：主语 + had + 过去分词（+ 其他）
when/as + 一般过去时（短动作）, 主句 + 过去进行时（长动作）
by the time + 一般过去时, 主句 + 过去完成时
否定与疑问：didn't + 动词原形 / wasn't/weren't + doing / hadn't + done
notes: 高考读后续写中，背景描写多用过去进行时，主线推进多用一般过去时，二者交替使用能增强画面感和节奏感。
书面语中，过去完成时常与 by the time、before、after、already、just 等连用，表示动作先后，避免只用一般过去时造成歧义。
瞬间动词（如 see、hear、notice、arrive、leave）一般不用于过去进行时表示主线动作，若用于进行时则往往表示“即将发生”或强调过程。
在 when/as 引导的时间状语从句中，若从句动作为短暂动作，主句动作为持续动作，则从句用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时；若两个动作先后发生，则都用一般过去时。
整段叙述中要注意时态锚点一致：一旦确定以过去时间为叙述基点，后续动作都应围绕过去时态展开，除非出现直接引语或客观真理。

examples.en: I visited my uncle last Sunday and we watched a football match together.
examples.cn: 我上周日拜访了我叔叔，我们一起看了一场足球比赛。

examples.en: While Mum was cooking, Dad was reading the newspaper in the living room.
examples.cn: 妈妈做饭的时候，爸爸在客厅看报纸。

examples.en: When I walked into the classroom, the teacher was writing on the blackboard.
examples.cn: 当我走进教室时，老师正在黑板上写字。

examples.en: By the time we got to the cinema, the film had already begun.
examples.cn: 我们到达电影院时，电影已经开始了。

examples.en: She was about to leave the office when she noticed that she had left her keys on the desk.
examples.cn: 她正要离开办公室时，发现把钥匙落在桌上了。

examples.en: The witness claimed that he had been walking past the building when he heard a loud crash from inside.
examples.cn: 目击者声称，他正从大楼旁经过时，听到里面传来一声巨响。

exercises.q: I ______ TV when my friend called me last night.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常与 when 连用。

exercises.q: She ______ her homework and then went to bed.
exercises.explain: 两个过去动作先后发生，都用一般过去时。

exercises.q: While I ______ in the park, I saw a beautiful bird.
exercises.explain: while 引导的从句常用过去进行时表示持续动作。

exercises.q: He ______ the door and entered the room quietly.
exercises.explain: 叙述过去连续动作时，主要动词用一般过去时。

exercises.q: They ______ football when it started to rain.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作，后接 when 从句。

exercises.q: I ______ (read) a book when my mother came home.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作。

exercises.q: She ______ (visit) her grandparents last Sunday.
exercises.explain: last Sunday 是过去时间状语，用一般过去时。

exercises.q: While they ______ (have) dinner, the phone rang.
exercises.explain: while 从句用过去进行时表示持续动作。

exercises.q: I was watching TV when he arrives.
exercises.explain: 主句用过去进行时，when 从句也应用过去时 arrives 应为 arrived。

exercises.q: She cooked dinner and then watched TV.
exercises.explain: 两个过去连续动作用一般过去时，时态一致正确。

exercises.q: I watched TV last night. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: I did not watch TV last night.
exercises.explain: 一般过去时否定句用 did not + 动词原形。

exercises.q: She was reading a book. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 过去进行时疑问句将 was/were 提前。

exercises.q: He played basketball yesterday. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 一般过去时疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形。

exercises.q: I was watch TV when he came in.
exercises.answer: I was watching TV when he came in.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时结构为 was/were + doing。

exercises.q: She go to school by bus yesterday.
exercises.answer: She went to school by bus yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 提示用一般过去时，go 的过去式是 went。

exercises.q: When I ______ into the classroom, the teacher was writing on the blackboard.
exercises.explain: when 引导的短暂动作用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时。

exercises.q: He ______ his keys while he was running to catch the bus.
exercises.explain: 在持续动作进行中发生的短暂动作用一般过去时。

exercises.q: The children ______ in the garden when their mother called them for dinner.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework while my sister was listening to music.
exercises.explain: while 连接两个同时进行的过去动作，都用过去进行时。

exercises.q: She ______ the room and turned on the light.
exercises.explain: 叙述过去连续动作时，主要动词用一般过去时。

exercises.q: When I saw him, he ______ (run) in the park.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作。

exercises.q: She ______ (write) a letter when the lights went out.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作，后接 when 从句。

exercises.q: They ______ (not go) to the party last night.
exercises.explain: 一般过去时否定句用 did not + 动词原形。

exercises.q: While I was cooking, the doorbell was ringing.
exercises.explain: doorbell rang 是短暂动作，应用一般过去时，不用过去进行时。

exercises.q: He was reading a book when I saw him.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时与 when 引导的一般过去时从句搭配正确。

exercises.q: They were playing football in the park. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: They were not playing football in the park.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时否定句在 was/were 后加 not。

exercises.q: She finished her homework at 8 pm. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Did she finish her homework at 8 pm?
exercises.explain: 一般过去时疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形。

exercises.q: I was doing my homework when he called. (对划线部分提问：when he called)
exercises.answer: What were you doing when he called?
exercises.explain: 对过去进行时动作提问用 What were you doing。

exercises.q: When I was arriving home, my mother was cooking dinner.
exercises.answer: When I arrived home, my mother was cooking dinner.
exercises.explain: arrive 是短暂动词，不用过去进行时，应用一般过去时。

exercises.q: She was reading while her brother was doing his homework.
exercises.answer: She was reading while her brother was doing his homework.
exercises.explain: 此句时态使用正确，无需修改。

exercises.q: By the time we ______ the station, the train had already left.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导的从句用一般过去时，主句用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in the company for five years before she got promoted.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时表示在过去某一动作之前已经完成的动作。

exercises.q: I ______ my keys and couldn't get into the house.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时表示过去某时之前已经发生的动作，强调结果。

exercises.q: While I ______ in the library, I found an interesting book.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作，后接短暂动作。

exercises.q: He told me that he ______ the movie before.
exercises.explain: 宾语从句中，主句用过去时，从句表示更早发生的动作用过去完成时。

exercises.q: After she ______ (finish) her work, she went home.
exercises.explain: after 引导的从句用过去完成时表示先于主句动作完成。

exercises.q: He ______ (wait) for an hour before the bus finally arrived.
exercises.explain: 过去完成进行时表示过去某时之前一直持续的动作。

exercises.q: When I got to the cinema, the film ______ (already start).
exercises.explain: 过去完成时表示在过去某时之前已经发生的动作。

exercises.q: She had finished her homework before she went to bed.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时与一般过去时搭配，表示动作先后顺序，使用正确。

exercises.q: He was watching TV when I had arrived.
exercises.explain: when 从句中的短暂动作用一般过去时 arrived，不用过去完成时。

exercises.q: I finished my homework. Then I went to bed. (用 after 合并句子)
exercises.answer: After I had finished my homework, I went to bed.
exercises.explain: after 引导的从句用过去完成时表示先完成的动作。

exercises.q: She was cooking dinner when the phone rang. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She was not cooking dinner when the phone rang.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时否定句在 was/were 后加 not。

exercises.q: They had left before I arrived. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Had they left before I arrived?
exercises.explain: 过去完成时疑问句将 had 提前。

exercises.q: After he has finished his work, he went home.
exercises.answer: After he had finished his work, he went home.
exercises.explain: 主句用一般过去时，after 从句应用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She said that she will come to the party.
exercises.answer: She said that she would come to the party.
exercises.explain: 主句用一般过去时，宾语从句中的 will 应改为 would。

exercises.q: When I ______ into the classroom, the teacher was writing on the blackboard.
exercises.explain: 主句用过去进行时表示正在进行的动作，when 引导的从句用一般过去时表示突然发生的动作。

exercises.q: She ______ her homework while her brother was playing video games.
exercises.explain: while 引导的时间状语从句中，两个过去同时进行的动作常用过去进行时。

exercises.q: He ______ the door, turned off the lights, and went to bed.
exercises.explain: 叙述过去一连串先后发生的动作时，各动词都用一般过去时保持时态一致。

exercises.q: As I ______ down the street, I saw an old friend from primary school.
exercises.explain: as 引导的从句中，过去进行时表示背景动作，主句用一般过去时表示突然发生的事件。

exercises.q: The children ______ in the garden when it started to rain.
exercises.explain: when 引导的从句用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作。

exercises.q: While my mother ______ (cook) dinner, my father was reading a newspaper.
exercises.explain: while 引导的从句中，过去同时进行的动作用过去进行时。

exercises.q: I ______ (meet) my best friend at the school gate yesterday morning.
exercises.explain: yesterday morning 是明确的过去时间状语，动词用一般过去时。

exercises.q: They ______ (watch) TV when the phone rang.
exercises.explain: when 引导的从句用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时表示正在进行的动作。

exercises.q: The sentence "She was reading a book when I called her" means she finished reading before I called.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时表示打电话时她正在读书，并非已经读完。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He opened the window and looked outside", both verbs are in the Simple Past tense.
exercises.explain: opened 和 looked 都是一般过去时，表示先后发生的两个过去动作。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in the negative form: "She visited her grandparents last Sunday."
exercises.answer: She did not visit her grandparents last Sunday.
exercises.explain: 一般过去时的否定形式用 did not + 动词原形。

exercises.q: Change the statement into a question: "They were playing basketball at 5 pm yesterday."
exercises.answer: Were they playing basketball at 5 pm yesterday?
exercises.explain: 过去进行时的一般疑问句将 were 提到主语之前。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "while": "I was doing my homework. My sister was listening to music."
exercises.answer: While I was doing my homework, my sister was listening to music.
exercises.explain: while 连接两个同时进行的过去动作，两个分句都用过去进行时。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: "When I was arriving at school, the bell rang."
exercises.answer: When I arrived at school, the bell rang.
exercises.explain: arrive 是短暂性动词，不用于过去进行时，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: "He was watching TV and then he goes to bed."
exercises.answer: He was watching TV and then he went to bed.
exercises.explain: 叙述过去事件时，前后时态应保持一致，goes 应改为 went。

exercises.q: By the time we ______ the station, the train had already left.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般过去时，主句用过去完成时表示更早发生的动作。

exercises.q: She said she ______ the film before, so she didn't want to watch it again.
exercises.explain: 宾语从句中，主句用一般过去时，从句表示更早发生的动作用过去完成时。

exercises.q: While I ______ in the library, I suddenly remembered I had left my keys at home.
exercises.explain: while 引导的从句用过去进行时表示背景动作，主句用一般过去时表示突然想起。

exercises.q: The teacher noticed that one student ______ asleep during the lesson.
exercises.explain: notice 用一般过去时，宾语从句中表示更早发生的状态用过去完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ for three hours before he finally took a break.
exercises.explain: 过去完成进行时强调动作在过去某一时间之前持续进行了一段时间。

exercises.q: After she ______ (finish) her homework, she went out to play with her friends.
exercises.explain: after 引导的从句中，先完成的动作用过去完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ (read) the novel for two hours when my friend called me.
exercises.explain: 过去完成进行时表示在过去某一时间点之前持续进行的动作。

exercises.q: When I got home, I realized that I ______ (forget) to lock the door.
exercises.explain: realize 用一般过去时，宾语从句中更早发生的动作用过去完成时。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He had left before I arrived", the action of leaving happened after the action of arriving.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时 had left 表示离开发生在到达之前。

exercises.q: The sentence "She was cooking dinner when the guests arrived" means the guests arrived during the cooking process.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时表示客人到达时她正在做饭，动作正在进行中。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "before": "He finished his homework. Then he watched TV."
exercises.answer: He had finished his homework before he watched TV.
exercises.explain: before 连接两个过去动作时，先发生的动作用过去完成时。

exercises.q: Change the direct speech into reported speech: "I am reading a book," she said.
exercises.answer: She said that she was reading a book.
exercises.explain: 直接引语变间接引语时，现在进行时需改为过去进行时。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "no sooner...than": "The bell rang. The students rushed out of the classroom."
exercises.answer: No sooner had the bell rung than the students rushed out of the classroom.
exercises.explain: no sooner...than 结构中，no sooner 后的动作用过去完成时，than 后的动作用一般过去时。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: "When I arrived at the party, everyone already went home."
exercises.answer: When I arrived at the party, everyone had already gone home.
exercises.explain: arrived 之前已经发生的动作应用过去完成时 had gone。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: "She told me that she has finished her project."
exercises.answer: She told me that she had finished her project.
exercises.explain: 主句用一般过去时 told，宾语从句中的现在完成时需改为过去完成时。

exercises.q: Hardly ______ the office when the phone started ringing.
exercises.explain: hardly...when 结构中，hardly 置于句首时主句需部分倒装，且用过去完成时。

exercises.q: The witness claimed that she ______ the suspect leaving the building at approximately 9 pm.
exercises.explain: claim 用一般过去时，宾语从句中表示更早发生的动作用过去完成时。

exercises.q: By the end of last year, the company ______ over 500 new employees.
exercises.explain: by the end of last year 是过去完成时的标志性时间状语。

exercises.q: She ______ to leave the house when she realized she had forgotten her passport.
exercises.explain: was about to do 表示过去即将发生的动作，常与 when 引导的从句连用。

exercises.q: The professor ______ the experiment for three years before he published the results.
exercises.explain: 过去完成进行时强调在过去某一时间点之前持续进行的动作，常与 for + 时间段连用。

exercises.q: Scarcely ______ (he / finish) his speech when the audience burst into applause.
exercises.explain: scarcely...when 结构中，scarcely 置于句首时主句需部分倒装，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: It was the first time that I ______ (see) such a spectacular sunset.
exercises.explain: It was the first time that 句型中，从句用过去完成时。

exercises.q: The detective discovered that the suspect ______ (lie) about his whereabouts on the night of the crime.
exercises.explain: 过去完成进行时表示在过去某一时间点之前持续进行的动作，强调说谎的持续性。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He had been working for six hours before he took a break", the working continued up to the moment of taking a break.
exercises.explain: 过去完成进行时表示动作持续到过去某一时间点，此处即持续到休息那一刻。

exercises.q: The sentence "I was going to call you, but I lost your number" implies that the speaker did call the listener.
exercises.explain: was going to 表示过去打算做但未实现的动作，说明说话人最终没有打电话。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using inversion: "The meeting had no sooner begun than the fire alarm went off."
exercises.answer: No sooner had the meeting begun than the fire alarm went off.
exercises.explain: no sooner 置于句首时，主句需部分倒装，将 had 提到主语之前。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "was/were to have done": "He intended to finish the report by Friday, but he didn't."
exercises.answer: He was to have finished the report by Friday, but he didn't.
exercises.explain: was/were to have done 表示过去计划或安排但未实现的动作。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "not until": "He didn't realize his mistake until he had read the report twice."
exercises.answer: Not until he had read the report twice did he realize his mistake.
exercises.explain: not until 置于句首时，主句需部分倒装，且从句用过去完成时。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: "Hardly had the concert begun when the power was cutting off."
exercises.answer: Hardly had the concert begun when the power was cut off.
exercises.explain: when 从句中的动作用一般过去时，且 cut off 在此处用被动语态的一般过去时。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: "She said she was working on the project since January."
exercises.answer: She said she had been working on the project since January.
exercises.explain: 间接引语中，现在完成进行时需改为过去完成进行时，表示从过去某时持续到说话时的动作。

grammar.key: Gerund as Object after 'couldn't stand' / 动名词作 'couldn't stand' 的宾语
grammar.title: 动名词作“can't stand / can't bear / can't help”等短语的宾语（含逻辑主语结构）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Object after 'can't stand / can't bear / can't help' (including the structure with a logical subject)
grammar.usage:
核心结构：在英语中，某些动词或动词短语后面只能接动名词（doing）作宾语，而不能接不定式（to do）。其中“can't stand”表示“无法忍受、极其讨厌”，后面必须接动名词作宾语。例如：I can't stand waiting in long lines.（我无法忍受排长队等候。）当需要说明“是谁在做这个动作”时，可以在动名词前面加上一个名词或形容词性物主代词，构成“can't stand + 某人/某物 + doing”的结构，这个“某人/某物”就是动名词的逻辑主语。例如：She can't stand her husband snoring at night.（她无法忍受她丈夫夜里打呼噜。）

肯定、否定与疑问形式：肯定式为“主语 + can't stand + doing”；否定式通常用“can stand + doing”表示“能忍受”，或“can't stand + not doing”表示“无法忍受不做某事”；疑问式将can提到主语前，如“Can you stand him smoking in the room?”。需要注意的是，“can't stand”本身已经含有否定意义，不要再加其他否定词造成双重否定。

与近义结构的对比：“can't stand”与“can't bear”意思非常接近，都表示“无法忍受”，两者后面都接动名词。“can't help”虽然结构相似，但意思不同，表示“忍不住做某事”，后面也接动名词，如“I can't help laughing.”。而“can't afford”后面接不定式，表示“负担不起做某事”，与“can't stand”形成对比。另外，“stand”作动词单独使用时，在否定句和疑问句中常接动名词，如“I can't stand seeing animals suffer.”。

初中用法 vs 高中用法：初中阶段主要掌握“can't stand + doing”的基本结构，以及常见的后接动名词的动词（如enjoy, mind, practice, finish等），通常只涉及简单的主语和动名词。高中阶段则需要进一步掌握“can't stand + 逻辑主语 + doing”的复杂结构，理解动名词的复合结构在句中的功能，并能在书面表达中灵活运用“can't stand / can't bear / can't help / feel like”等短语表达强烈情感或不由自主的行为。此外，高中还要求辨析动名词与不定式作宾语时的语义差异，以及动名词的被动式（being done）和完成式（having done）在宾语位置上的使用。

易错点：第一，误将“can't stand”后面的动词写成不定式，如“I can't stand to wait”是错误的，应改为“I can't stand waiting”。第二，在“can't stand + 逻辑主语 + doing”结构中，逻辑主语误用主格代词，如“I can't stand he smoking”应改为“I can't stand him smoking”或“I can't stand his smoking”。第三，混淆“can't stand doing”与“can't stand to do”的语义，实际上“stand”表示“忍受”时后面不接不定式，只有表示“站起来做某事”时才用不定式，如“He stood up to answer the question.”。第四，在书面表达中过度使用“can't stand”，忽略了“can't bear”“can't tolerate”“can't put up with”等近义表达的替换，导致语言单调。
forms: 主语 + can't stand + doing（肯定式）
主语 + can stand + doing（否定式，表示“能忍受”）
Can + 主语 + stand + doing?（疑问式）
主语 + can't stand + 名词/形容词性物主代词 + doing（含逻辑主语的动名词复合结构）
主语 + can't bear / can't help / feel like + doing（近义短语扩展）
主语 + can't stand + being done（动名词被动式作宾语）
notes: 高考书面表达中，使用“can't stand + 逻辑主语 + doing”结构可以提升句式的复杂度和表达的准确性，但要注意逻辑主语用宾格或形容词性物主代词，不要用主格。
在正式语域中，“can't stand”偏口语化，书面表达中可替换为“cannot tolerate”“cannot bear”“cannot put up with”等更正式的表达。
动名词作宾语时，如果动作发生在谓语动词之前，应使用完成式“having done”，如“She can't stand having been treated unfairly.”，这一点在高中语法填空和短文改错中常考。
注意“can't help doing”与“can't help to do”的区别：前者表示“忍不住做某事”，后者表示“不能帮忙做某事”，高考常以此设置干扰项。
在“can't stand + 动名词”结构中，动名词的否定形式是“not doing”，如“I can't stand not being able to sleep.”，不要写成“I can't stand don't sleep.”。

examples.en: I can't stand getting up early on cold winter mornings.
examples.cn: 我无法忍受在寒冷的冬天早晨早起。

examples.en: My little sister can't stand eating vegetables, especially carrots.
examples.cn: 我妹妹无法忍受吃蔬菜，尤其是胡萝卜。

examples.en: Can you stand your roommate playing loud music while you are studying?
examples.cn: 你能忍受你的室友在你学习的时候大声放音乐吗？

examples.en: She couldn't stand her classmates making fun of her accent, so she transferred to another school.
examples.cn: 她无法忍受同学们取笑她的口音，所以转到了另一所学校。

examples.en: Many commuters cannot bear being stuck in traffic jams for hours every day, yet they have no alternative.
examples.cn: 许多通勤者无法忍受每天在交通堵塞中困上几个小时，但他们别无选择。

examples.en: Having been criticized unfairly in public, the young researcher couldn't help feeling resentful, though she tried to remain composed.
examples.cn: 在公开场合被不公正地批评后，这位年轻的研究员忍不住感到愤愤不平，尽管她努力保持镇定。

exercises.q: I can't stand ______ in a long queue.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词作宾语，表示“无法忍受做某事”。

exercises.q: She couldn't stand her brother ______ her things.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，表示“无法忍受某人做某事”。

exercises.q: My father can't stand ______ loud music at night.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词短语 listening to 作宾语。

exercises.q: They couldn't stand ______ in the hot sun.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词 standing，表示“无法忍受站着”。

exercises.q: He can't stand his sister ______ all the time.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，表示“无法忍受某人一直抱怨”。

exercises.q: I can't stand ______ (do) homework on weekends.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词 doing 作宾语。

exercises.q: She couldn't stand her cat ______ (sleep) on her bed.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人/物 + 动名词，表示“无法忍受猫睡在床上”。

exercises.q: We can't stand ______ (hear) that noise.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词 hearing 作宾语。

exercises.q: The sentence "I can't stand to wait" is correct.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后应接动名词 waiting，而非不定式 to wait。

exercises.q: The sentence "He can't stand her singing loudly" is correct.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "can't stand": I don't like waiting for the bus.
exercises.answer: I can't stand waiting for the bus.
exercises.explain: 用 can't stand 替换 don't like，后接动名词 waiting。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "can't stand": She doesn't like her brother shouting.
exercises.answer: She can't stand her brother shouting.
exercises.explain: 用 can't stand 替换 doesn't like，后接 her brother shouting。

exercises.q: Change the sentence to negative: He can stand getting up early.
exercises.answer: He can't stand getting up early.
exercises.explain: 将 can stand 改为否定形式 can't stand，动名词保持不变。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: I can't stand to listen to that song.
exercises.answer: I can't stand listening to that song.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后应接动名词 listening，而非不定式 to listen。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: She couldn't stand her friend to talk loudly.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand her friend talking loudly.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，应将 to talk 改为 talking。

exercises.q: He couldn't stand ______ his homework every day.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词 doing 作宾语。

exercises.q: My mother can't stand me ______ video games for hours.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，表示“无法忍受我长时间玩游戏”。

exercises.q: They couldn't stand ______ in the rain without an umbrella.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词 walking 作宾语。

exercises.q: I can't stand people ______ on the phone loudly in public.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，表示“无法忍受人们在公共场合大声打电话”。

exercises.q: She couldn't stand ______ the same question again and again.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词 answering 作宾语。

exercises.q: My father can't stand ______ (watch) soap operas.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词 watching 作宾语。

exercises.q: We couldn't stand the baby ______ (cry) all night.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人/物 + 动名词，表示“无法忍受婴儿整夜哭”。

exercises.q: He can't stand his classmates ______ (make) fun of him.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，表示“无法忍受同学取笑他”。

exercises.q: The sentence "I can't stand him to smoke in the room" is correct.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，应将 to smoke 改为 smoking。

exercises.q: The sentence "She can't stand being late for school" is correct.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词 being，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "couldn't stand": He disliked his neighbors making noise at night.
exercises.answer: He couldn't stand his neighbors making noise at night.
exercises.explain: 用 couldn't stand 替换 disliked，后接 his neighbors making noise。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "can't stand": I really don't like getting up early on weekends.
exercises.answer: I can't stand getting up early on weekends.
exercises.explain: 用 can't stand 替换 don't like，后接动名词 getting up。

exercises.q: Change the sentence to negative: She could stand her brother borrowing her clothes.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand her brother borrowing her clothes.
exercises.explain: 将 could stand 改为否定形式 couldn't stand，动名词保持不变。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: They can't stand to hear the baby cry.
exercises.answer: They can't stand hearing the baby cry.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后应接动名词 hearing，而非不定式 to hear。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: He couldn't stand his dog to bark at night.
exercises.answer: He couldn't stand his dog barking at night.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人/物 + 动名词，应将 to bark 改为 barking。

exercises.q: Having lived in the countryside for years, she couldn't stand ______ in such a crowded city.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词 living 作宾语，表示“无法忍受住在拥挤的城市”。

exercises.q: The manager couldn't stand his employees ______ late without any explanation.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，表示“无法忍受员工无故迟到”。

exercises.q: I can't stand ______ interrupted when I'm concentrating on my work.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词被动式 being interrupted，表示“无法忍受被打断”。

exercises.q: She couldn't stand the thought of ______ her children suffer.
exercises.explain: 介词 of 后接动名词 seeing，构成 the thought of seeing。

exercises.q: He couldn't stand ______ by others for his accent.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词被动式 being laughed at，表示“无法忍受被嘲笑”。

exercises.q: She couldn't stand ______ (treat) like a child by her parents.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词被动式 being treated，表示“无法忍受被当作孩子对待”。

exercises.q: The teacher can't stand students ______ (use) their phones in class.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，表示“无法忍受学生在课堂上用手机”。

exercises.q: He couldn't stand ______ (remind) of his failure again and again.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词被动式 being reminded，表示“无法忍受被反复提醒失败”。

exercises.q: The sentence "I can't stand being kept waiting for a long time" is correct.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词被动式 being kept waiting，结构正确。

exercises.q: The sentence "She couldn't stand him to interrupt her while she was speaking" is correct.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，应将 to interrupt 改为 interrupting。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "couldn't stand": He disliked being told what to do all the time.
exercises.answer: He couldn't stand being told what to do all the time.
exercises.explain: 用 couldn't stand 替换 disliked，后接动名词被动式 being told。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "can't stand": I really don't like people criticizing my work without understanding it.
exercises.answer: I can't stand people criticizing my work without understanding it.
exercises.explain: 用 can't stand 替换 don't like，后接 people criticizing my work。

exercises.q: Change the sentence to negative: She could stand her colleagues gossiping about her.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand her colleagues gossiping about her.
exercises.explain: 将 could stand 改为否定形式 couldn't stand，动名词保持不变。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: He can't stand to be ignored by his friends.
exercises.answer: He can't stand being ignored by his friends.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后应接动名词被动式 being ignored，而非不定式 to be ignored。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: She couldn't stand her husband to leave his clothes everywhere.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand her husband leaving his clothes everywhere.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 某人 + 动名词，应将 to leave 改为 leaving。

exercises.q: My sister couldn't stand ______ the same song again and again.
exercises.explain: couldn't stand 后接动名词作宾语，表示无法忍受做某事。

exercises.q: He couldn't stand his roommate ______ loudly on the phone at midnight.
exercises.explain: couldn't stand + 某人 + 动名词，表示无法忍受某人做某事。

exercises.q: Which verb phrase is followed by a gerund?
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词，而 want、decide、hope 后接不定式。

exercises.q: I couldn't stand ______ in the long queue for two hours.
exercises.explain: 动名词 waiting 作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: She couldn't stand her little brother ______ her things without asking.
exercises.explain: her little brother 是动名词 taking 的逻辑主语，整体作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: My father couldn't stand ______ (listen) to loud rock music.
exercises.explain: couldn't stand 后必须用动名词形式。

exercises.q: We couldn't stand the baby ______ (cry) all night.
exercises.explain: the baby 是动名词 crying 的逻辑主语。

exercises.q: He couldn't stand ______ (be) late for school every day.
exercises.explain: be 的动名词形式是 being，作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: The sentence "I can't stand to wait in line" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: can't stand 后接动名词，应改为 waiting。

exercises.q: In the sentence "She couldn't stand him singing", "singing" is a gerund.
exercises.explain: singing 是动名词，him 是其逻辑主语，整体作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "couldn't stand": I disliked waiting for the bus in the rain.
exercises.answer: I couldn't stand waiting for the bus in the rain.
exercises.explain: 用 couldn't stand + 动名词替换 dislike + 动名词，表达更强烈的厌恶。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "couldn't stand": She hated her dog barking at night.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand her dog barking at night.
exercises.explain: couldn't stand + 逻辑主语 + 动名词，表示无法忍受某人或某物做某事。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "couldn't stand": He disliked people talking during the movie.
exercises.answer: He couldn't stand people talking during the movie.
exercises.explain: people 是动名词 talking 的逻辑主语，整体作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: I couldn't stand to hear the noise from the construction site.
exercises.answer: I couldn't stand hearing the noise from the construction site.
exercises.explain: couldn't stand 后接动名词，不能接不定式。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She couldn't stand her neighbor play loud music every night.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand her neighbor playing loud music every night.
exercises.explain: her neighbor 后应接动名词 playing，构成 couldn't stand + 逻辑主语 + 动名词结构。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived, she couldn't stand ______ for us any longer and had already left.
exercises.explain: couldn't stand 后接动名词作宾语，表示无法继续忍受等待。

exercises.q: He couldn't stand ______ at by his classmates, so he decided to change his behavior.
exercises.explain: 此处需要动名词的被动形式 being laughed，表示无法忍受被嘲笑。

exercises.q: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: I can't stand him to interrupt me all the time.
I can't stand him interrupting me all the time.
I can't stand him interrupts me all the time.
I can't stand him interrupted me all the time.
exercises.answer: I can't stand him interrupting me all the time.
exercises.explain: can't stand + 逻辑主语（him）+ 动名词（interrupting）是正确结构。

exercises.q: She couldn't stand ______ the same mistakes over and over again in her students' essays.
exercises.explain: couldn't stand 后接动名词 seeing，表示无法忍受反复看到。

exercises.q: My grandfather couldn't stand ______ what to do by anyone.
exercises.explain: 动名词被动式 being told 表示无法忍受被别人指使。

exercises.q: She couldn't stand ______ (interrupt) while she was working on her project.
exercises.explain: 此处需要动名词的被动形式 being interrupted，表示被打断。

exercises.q: He couldn't stand his colleagues ______ (gossip) about him behind his back.
exercises.explain: his colleagues 是动名词 gossiping 的逻辑主语。

exercises.q: I couldn't stand ______ (keep) waiting without any explanation.
exercises.explain: being kept waiting 是动名词被动式，表示被使等待。

exercises.q: The sentence "She couldn't stand being ignored by her friends" means she strongly disliked it when her friends ignored her.
exercises.explain: being ignored 是动名词被动式，表示无法忍受被忽视。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He couldn't stand his phone ringing during meetings", "ringing" is an infinitive.
exercises.explain: ringing 是动名词，不是不定式，作 his phone 的补足语。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "couldn't stand": She disliked being treated like a child.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand being treated like a child.
exercises.explain: 用 couldn't stand + 动名词被动式替换 dislike + 动名词被动式。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "couldn't stand": He hated his neighbors playing loud music at night.
exercises.answer: He couldn't stand his neighbors playing loud music at night.
exercises.explain: his neighbors 是动名词 playing 的逻辑主语，整体作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "couldn't stand": I disliked people constantly checking their phones during dinner.
exercises.answer: I couldn't stand people constantly checking their phones during dinner.
exercises.explain: people 是动名词 checking 的逻辑主语，constantly 修饰动名词。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She couldn't stand to be criticized in front of others.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand being criticized in front of others.
exercises.explain: couldn't stand 后接动名词，不能用不定式。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He couldn't stand his boss shout at him in public.
exercises.answer: He couldn't stand his boss shouting at him in public.
exercises.explain: his boss 后应接动名词 shouting，构成 couldn't stand + 逻辑主语 + 动名词。

exercises.q: Having been kept waiting for over an hour, she couldn't stand ______ any longer and walked out of the office.
exercises.explain: being ignored 是动名词被动式，作 couldn't stand 的宾语，表示无法忍受被忽视。

exercises.q: The manager couldn't stand his subordinates ______ excuses for their repeated failures.
exercises.explain: his subordinates 是动名词 making 的逻辑主语，整体作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: Which of the following sentences contains a gerund as the object of "couldn't stand"?
options: She couldn't stand to see him suffer.
She couldn't stand seeing him suffer.
She couldn't stand him to suffer.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand seeing him suffer.
exercises.explain: seeing 是动名词，作 couldn't stand 的宾语，符合语法规则。

exercises.q: He couldn't stand ______ by his colleagues as an outsider, so he resigned.
exercises.explain: being regarded 是动名词被动式，表示无法忍受被当作外人看待。

exercises.q: The teacher couldn't stand her students ______ their assignments at the last minute.
exercises.explain: her students 是动名词 submitting 的逻辑主语，整体作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: She couldn't stand ______ (patronize) by people who knew far less than she did.
exercises.explain: being patronized 是动名词被动式，表示无法忍受被居高临下地对待。

exercises.q: He couldn't stand his ideas ______ (dismiss) without proper consideration.
exercises.explain: his ideas 是动名词被动式 being dismissed 的逻辑主语。

exercises.q: I couldn't stand ______ (remind) constantly of my past failures.
exercises.explain: being reminded 是动名词被动式，作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: The sentence "She couldn't stand his constant complaining about trivial matters" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: his constant complaining 是动名词短语，作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He couldn't stand being made fun of", "being made fun of" is a gerund phrase in the passive voice.
exercises.explain: being made fun of 是动名词短语的被动形式，作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "couldn't stand": She found it intolerable that her colleagues were constantly undermining her authority.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand her colleagues constantly undermining her authority.
exercises.explain: 用 couldn't stand + 逻辑主语 + 动名词替换 find it intolerable that 从句。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "couldn't stand": He hated being interrupted when he was in the middle of a complex calculation.
exercises.answer: He couldn't stand being interrupted when he was in the middle of a complex calculation.
exercises.explain: 用 couldn't stand + 动名词被动式替换 hate + 动名词被动式。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "couldn't stand": The professor disliked students checking their phones during his lectures.
exercises.answer: The professor couldn't stand students checking their phones during his lectures.
exercises.explain: students 是动名词 checking 的逻辑主语，整体作 couldn't stand 的宾语。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She couldn't stand to be patronized by her younger colleagues.
exercises.answer: She couldn't stand being patronized by her younger colleagues.
exercises.explain: couldn't stand 后接动名词，不能用不定式。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He couldn't stand his privacy invade by the paparazzi.
exercises.answer: He couldn't stand his privacy being invaded by the paparazzi.
exercises.explain: his privacy 后应接动名词被动式 being invaded，构成 couldn't stand + 逻辑主语 + 动名词被动式。
